10303573.en: She stole the half jade from the Taoist Mind Pavilion at the time of our first meet, and after many failed searches, I could only steal the other part from the Mindsnap Temple in turn as my retaliation.
10303573.ch: 你我初遇之际，“她”窃走了道心阁的花玉。我遍寻不着，便也以牙还牙，设法盗出了蚀心殿的收藏的另一半花玉。

10303574.en: We are in the same body, and our every action will inevitably be noticed by the other. If we want to let something go completely unnoticed, we need to hide it in the most unexpected place. So I put the jade on you, hoping to take it back after we settled our matters.
10303574.ch: 我与她共用一个身体，平日一举一动都容易留下蛛丝马迹让对方察觉，只有将玉璧藏在最为意想不到的地方，才能瞒过对方。因此我便偷偷将玉璧藏在你身上，盼望日后情况稳定后再设法从你身上取回。

10303575.en: However, I was caught in trouble and was unable to get it back till now. What really surprised me is that she also chose to hide the jade from the Taoist Mind Pavilion in the same place. Alas! I didn't expect that the two parts are both in the bosom of the person that is standing before me...
10303575.ch: 只不过后来迭经变故，一直没有机会拿回来，这东西便一直都留在你身上了。而她取走道心阁的花玉，却也与我一般心思，冒险将玉璧藏到你身上了。唉，万万没想到我们千辛万苦寻找的东西也都就在眼前……

10303576.en: {name|B}'s eyes are brimming with tears. She puts the jade into your hands hastily and turns to leave. Roads unfold before {name|B}, and seeing her walking through the wilderness into the distance, you wonder where will she go in this vast world...
10303576.ch: {name|B}百感交集，泪眼婆娑。她匆匆将玉璧塞到你手中，便急急转过身去迈步离开了。旷野长天，人影渐远。{name|B}面前虽然广漠无垠，却四通八达，然则今后她又会到哪理去呢？

10303577.en: Seeing you take the jade, {name|B}'s eyes redden. Tears stream down from her eyes, and she hastily turns to leave. Roads unfold before {name|B}, and seeing her walking through the wilderness into the distance, you wonder where will she go in this vast world...
10303577.ch: 你收下花玉，{name|B}眼圈却突然一红，泪水汹涌而出。她急急扭过头迈开步子走向远方。其时旷野长天，人影渐远。{name|B}面前虽然广漠无垠，却四通八达，然则今后她又会到哪理去呢？

10303586.en: Seeing you take the jade, {name|B} wipes her eyes hastily and turns to leave. Roads unfold before {name|B}, and seeing her walking through the wilderness into the distance, you wonder where will she go in this vast world...
10303586.ch: 你收下花玉后，{name|B}迅速的伸手擦了擦眼睛，然后扭过头迈开步子走向远方。其时旷野长天，人影渐远。{name|B}面前虽然广漠无垠，却四通八达，然则今后她又会到哪理去呢？

10303587.en: {name|B} is standing on a hill and is looking into the distance. To your surprise, her expression is blank as if she is only half-awake. Suddenly, the lady quivers. She seems to be at a loss after waking from a long dream.
10303587.ch: {name|B}站在高冈上远眺风景，然而她神情木讷，似睡非睡，状态十分奇怪。突然间她身体微微一震，然后满脸都是茫然之色，看着就像做了一场梦，突然醒了过来。

10303589.en: Worries? Everyone has worries. I am worrying about trifles.
10303589.ch: 心事？这世上谁又没心事。我心中都是些琐碎的小事罢了。

10303590.en: I am thinking about a dream I had just now... well, last night. I saw a vast ground and fighting people. I tried to escape but found the gate was closed...
10303590.ch: 我不过想到刚刚……昨晚做的一场梦。梦里面我看见一个广大的场地，大家都在厮杀，我想逃出去，但大门却关起来了……

10303591.en: I have a thought sometimes. I think people can negotiate with each other and cooperate in common aims. Why do people fight and kill?
10303591.ch: 有时我会想，人啊其实可以坐下来好好谈谈，好好合作也是一件很不错的事。何必一定要你死我活呢？

10303593.en: Thank you for listening to my thoughts. Well, I made some pastries recently, and I'll share them with you.
10303593.ch: 偶尔有人陪着说说心事真好，多谢你。对了，我做了一些点心，送你几个尝尝。

10303594.en: {name|B} waves goodbye to you and leaves.
10303594.ch: {name|B}朝你挥了挥手，便转身离去了。

10303598.en: Well. I made some pastries during my rest. I'll share them with you.
10303598.ch: 对了，近日养伤期间得了闲暇，我试着做了一些点心，送你几个尝尝。

10303600.en: No, but I always have a feeling that I am actually someone else. I am even afraid that I won't wake up after a sleep.
10303600.ch: 没有不舒服。就是总有一种错觉，觉得自己不是自己。有时候真害怕一觉睡过去，就不会醒来了。

10303601.en: Indeed. But there are too many moments that we could only follow the course of our fate.
10303601.ch: 你说得不错，可是很多时候，生而为人，却感觉自己的命都轮不到自己做主呢。

10303604.en: Yes. All travelers must be back. Maybe we will both be back into the death, the nothingness.
10303604.ch: 是啊，活着，我们就像一个过客。过客总要回到属于自己的地方的，也许死就是人最大归宿呢？

10303607.en: {name|B} is standing on a hill and is looking into the distance with much grimness.
10303607.ch: {name|B}站在高冈上一脸煞气的看着远方。

10303608.en: You are wandering all the day. What a leisurely life.
10303608.ch: 老是晃悠晃悠的，你很闲嘛。

10303609.en: Okay. Now you know I am safe and sound and sober. You can go away.
10303609.ch: 那现在看到了？我精神抖擞，四肢完整，你可以走了。

10303610.en: What did I look like before? Soft, tender, and considerate? I pretended to be such a woman, and only the one now is the true me. Do you feel disillusioned?
10303610.ch: 之前我是怎么样的？很温柔，很善解人意？那是我故意装出来的，现在才是真正的我，明白了吧？你是不是很失望？

10303611.en: Sigh. I'm just... feeling somewhat annoyed. Please don't talk to me right now. Take this gift as my apologies.
10303611.ch: 唉……我就是有点烦躁……你还是暂时别跟我说话了吧。这是赔礼，拿着吧。

10303612.en: You find a slight feeling of guilt in {name|B}'s wicked expression. She puts something into your hands and leaves in a hurry.
10303612.ch: {name|B}充满邪气的脸上微露歉意，她将一个小东西塞给你，然后急急转身走了。

10303613.en: {name|B} seems to be disturbed. She finishes speaking and looks into the distance again, trying to find something.
10303613.ch: {name|B}似乎十分烦躁，说完以后，重新眺望远方，似乎正在寻找什么的样子。

10303614.en: Heh. What a sharp-witted person. Listen. If you want to hide something, you will stuff it to where? You can only pick a place around you now.
10303614.ch: 呦，真是个牙尖嘴利的家伙。你来，我问你。如果你要藏起什么东西来，你会在眼前哪个地方藏呢？

10303615.en: What if it's me that wants to hide something?
10303615.ch: 有没有可能是我想要藏什么东西呢？

10303616.en: I am going to hide an important thing, but where could I put it... I'm running out of time, and I must pick a safe place as soon as possible...
10303616.ch: 我要将重要的东西藏起来……藏在哪呢？时间不多了……要尽快……

10303618.en: {name|B} puts something into your hands and looks into the distance again.
10303618.ch: {name|B}将东西塞到你手中，便重新聚精会神看着远方。

10303620.en: Your ideas are useless. But take it. My gratitude for your effort in helping me think.
10303620.ch: 鬼点子没用，不过看在你肯出谋划策的份上，送你个小东西。

10303622.en: Hmph, silver-tongued. I'll take it as your compliment.
10303622.ch: 哼，真会讨“我”欢喜啊，油嘴滑舌的东西。

10303623.en: And have a taste of that. It fits well with honey-tongued people.
10303623.ch: 来，看你油嘴滑舌爱讨人欢心，送你个东西尝尝。

10303625.en: {name|B} is crouching on a hill and is looking into the distance. She seems to be worrying; her expression is sad.
10303625.ch: {name|B}蹲坐小丘上，看着远处风景。她一脸哀色，愁情并未散去。

10303628.en: Am I looking preoccupied? Well, yes. I have few friends, and no one would care about my thoughts. And even I would forget to care about my moods in the end.
10303628.ch: 我看起来很不开心吗？哦，对了。我没什么朋友，谁又会在意我开不开心呢？到最后便连我自己都忘关注自己到底开心还是不开心了。

10303629.en: I guess I look rather preoccupied. That's it.

10303630.en: Everything will pass, but they won't follow the course I hoped.
10303630.ch: 一切都会过去，只是不会按着我希望的方向过去罢了。

10303631.en: Yes? Seems that we are too feeble to direct the fate. It would be wonderful if someday we become the master of our destiny and make decisions for ourselves.
10303631.ch: 是吗？半点不由人呢。如果有一天我们都能掌握自己的幸运，自己做决定，那该多好？

10303632.en: Maybe you'll ridicule my thought. I'm thinking about her, the other me. We stay in the same body, but we never meet each other. I wonder what kind of person is she.
10303632.ch: 说来荒谬。其实我想的是“她”，另一个我。她和我都在用同一个身体活动，我们之间竟是素未谋面。我很想知道她是一个怎么样的人。

10303633.en: Well? Why... would she be fierce?

10303634.en: Deceitful? Did she do something to you?
10303634.ch: 阴险？她是对你做了什么吗？

10303635.en: After all we bear the same name.

10303637.en: I... want to speak to her, to be honest.
10303637.ch: 我……其实挺想跟她说说话的。

10303639.en: You feel something pressing on your shoulder. It's {name|B} leaning her head on your side.
10303639.ch: 你觉得肩膀微微一沉，转头看时，{name|B}已轻轻靠在你身边。

10303640.en: I'm so tired. I'll rest here for a moment. Only a moment.
10303640.ch: 好累，给我靠一会，就一会。

10303641.en: (Giggles.) She won't be happy to hear that, I guess.
10303641.ch: 噗呲，你这样说，只怕下回她要找你算账。

10303644.en: You feel the scent from {name|B}'s hair. She may have already fallen asleep now, and her breaths soften down. Suddenly, with a slight quiver, {name|B} sits up again.
10303644.ch: {name|B}秀发香泽微闻，她气息渐渐绵长似乎已经睡了过去。不过就在此时{name|B}身躯微微一颤，重新坐了起来。

10303646.en: Hmph. You are extremely considerate in dealing with young ladies. Have your words got her head over heels in love?
10303646.ch: 哼，好会怜香惜玉。你说了些什么好话？把人家迷得神魂颠倒了吧？

10303647.en: I see. I guess there were not any good words regarding me.
10303647.ch: 不问可知，一定是在说我坏话了。

10303648.en: I want to talk to her too. I want to scold her badly. Why is she so silly? Why did she get herself involved in the fight between the Pavilion and the Temple?
10303648.ch: 我也想和她说话。狠狠的骂她一顿。这傻子，又何苦卷进道心阁和蚀心殿的争端之中呢。

10303649.en: Oh. And I have a question. Do you feel me troublesome? If I died, you could flirt with her, right?
10303649.ch: 哼，我问你，你是不是觉得我很碍事？最好我死掉了，你就可以和她卿卿我我了，对吧？

10303650.en: Reconcile with her? She wants to kill me!
10303650.ch: 和解？她想要了我的命呢！

10303651.en: But it seems that you are somewhat hoping for me to die because you could express your affection to her freely if I were gone, right?
10303651.ch: 不过我看你倒是很乐意我死掉的。这样一来你就可以跟她耳鬓厮磨了，对吧？

10303652.en: Hearing your words, {name|B} looks at you carefully for some moments. Then a faint smile emerges on her lips, and when you're wondering about her plan, {name|B} gets closer to your side and leaves a brief kiss on your cheek.
10303652.ch: {name|B}闻言，细细的打量了你一阵子，随后嘴角掀起一丝不易察觉的笑意。你正疑惑时，{name|B}已靠了过来，小嘴蜻蜓点水般在你脸上印了一下。

10303653.en: I remember your words. You should remember your words too. Bye.
10303653.ch: 我记住你说的话了。希望你也记住自己说过的话。走了。

10303655.en: {name|B} beams upon hearing your words, but the next second her expression is sad again. She sighs and stands up, then walks to her home alone.
10303655.ch: {name|B}闻言笑逐颜开，但眨眼间又变得十分哀伤，她叹口气站了起来，自个儿回到家中了。

10303656.en: I found a wonderful place. Do you want to travel there with me?
10303656.ch: 我发现有个有趣的地方，你能陪我去一趟吗？

10303657.en: I'll wait for you there. Remember to show up... on time.
10303657.ch: 我在那边等候。你……一定要来。

10303659.en: I miss you badly... Do you have any free time now? Let's have a Dual Cultivation, right?
10303659.ch: 我很想你……你有空吗？我可以和你双修吗？

10303662.en: {name|B} is standing on a hill and is looking into the distance. She comes to you after noticing you're here.
10303662.ch: {name|B}站在小丘上远眺景致，她看到了你便朝你走过来了。

10303663.en: I heard that you came to this place, so I went here to find you. Luckily we meet before you leave.
10303663.ch: 我听说你在这附近，所以特意过来的。我还怕错过了呢，所幸总算遇上了。

10303664.en: I found something recently and I thought it would be useful for your cultivation, so I decided to give it to you.
10303664.ch: 这是我近日找到的东西，估计对你修炼有些帮助，就想着把东西带来了送给你。

10303665.en: {name|B} gives the gift to you and waves you goodbye with a smile. Then, she walks into the distance.
10303665.ch: {name|B}将东西交给你后，朝你笑了笑便挥手作别，朝远方去了。

10303667.en: Maybe I have seen you elsewhere some days before, but you disappeared the next moment, and I couldn't find you again even if I tried to chase you.
10303667.ch: 早些日子，我好像在别处看见你，但眨眼间就不见你踪影，追上去也已找不到了。

10303668.en: But I noticed you looked tired at that time. I prepared a cup of tea recently, and today you may have a try on it. I hope it can bring you refreshment.
10303668.ch: 当时我看你气色不是很好，就想到近日煮的一个茶汤颇能消解疲乏，便带来给你了。

10303718.en: You see a deserted battlefield strewn with the bodies of the fallen, and you remember {name|B} marked the place in the letter on the day she left.
10303718.ch: 只见前方一片狼藉，遍地伏尸。你依稀记得这正是当日{name|B}留书出走时标记的地点。

10303720.en:
At least I can prevent the conflict now from worsening. They have killed many opposite members because of the Reunion Circle.
No need to do that! The Reunion Circle is here. I've found it. Now if I hand it to the Taoist Mind Pavilion, things will be settled.
Elder Tianxuan has learned how to eliminate her from Senior Tianyi, which is the same reason I visited the senior.
10303720.ch:
不过我可以阻止眼前的争端。此次为了“道一心环”，他们已经互相杀害对方很多成员了。
这完全没有必要。我已经找到“道一心环”了。我只要将之交给道心阁，就能平息他们之间的争端。
天玄长老其实早已从天一前辈处获知杀死“她”的法子，我也由此辗转找到天一前辈。

10303721.en:
She is under the command of Bitterfly, and I guess Bitterfly must have known how to kill me.
But never mind. Now it's time to make my own choice.
My own!
10303721.ch:
她，是蝶怨的手下。想必蝶怨也已掌握杀死我的法子。
不过这没关系了，这次我要自己选一次。
一定！

10303722.en: Maybe she has already died in the fight...
10303722.ch: 她已在这场大战中去世了吧……

10303723.en: You hear faint voices come with the distant wind...
10303723.ch: 天风徐徐，送来远方人语之声。

10303724.en: We really got involved in trouble the last time. Fortunately, the fight finally came to an end after both the Mindsnap Temple and the Taoist Mind Pavilion suffered heavy causalities. But why did we start disputing again on the Reunion Circle recently?
10303724.ch: 上次事件弄得那么大，蚀心殿损失颇为惨重，道心阁也讨不了好。不过总算分了胜负，怎么近日又为了道一心环争起来呢？

10303725.en: The fight between the two orders will continue unless one of them is eliminated.
10303725.ch: 除非其中一方死绝了，否则我们之间的争斗永远不会停止。

10303726.en: So what is the Reunion Circle?
10303726.ch: 这道一心环究竟是什么？

10303727.en: Hmph. A token for a peace negotiation between the two orders, maybe. It had long been lost after many disasters, and cultivators only found it recently.
10303727.ch: 哼，听闻道心阁蚀心殿和谈的信物。后来几度变故，失落不见。近日才被修仙者重新发掘出来呢。

10303728.en: So, Tianxuan and Elder Bitterfly both want to have the Circle in hand, to the extent that they have agreed to a decisive fight someday?
10303728.ch: 因此，天玄与蝶怨长老都想争取这个东西，乃至于择日决战，以决定归属？

10303729.en: The Reunion Circle is just an excuse. Their dispute will go on even if there is no such thing.
10303729.ch: 道一心环不过是个引子，就算没有这个东西也是会发生争端的。

10303730.en: My good friend, is all of this worthwhile?

10303731.en: The two sigh deeply as they talk. Then you hear steps fading into the distance. Maybe the two cultivators have left.
10303731.ch: 两人说到这里都是发出一声叹息，随后脚步声起，远去。想来，谈话之人已离开了。

10303732.en: You hear faint voices come from the wilderness near you.
10303732.ch: 你听得不远处的荒僻之地初来谈话声音。

10303733.en: She should be here, but why couldn't we find her? Well, I wonder why it must be her? Why did our leader want to capture her at any cost?
10303733.ch: 明明就是在这附近，怎么就找不着了。喂，她到底有什么特别？值得劳师动众去拿下来？

10303734.en: Hey, don't you know that? She is really someone in Elder Tianxuan's eyes!
10303734.ch: 哼，你不知道吧？她，可是天玄长老十分看重的人呢？

10303735.en: What? Do you mean Tianxuan values a person from the Mindsnap Temple highly? Then why should he send us here?
10303735.ch: 什么？天玄长老对一个蚀心殿的人十分看重？那不至于派遣我们来拿人吧？

10303736.en: Because she's not a person. She's two persons. Our Elder Tianxuan values her highly, and the opponent Bitterfly, too.
10303736.ch: 因为她不是一个人。她是两个人。不但天玄长老看重她，对面蝶怨妖妇也看重她。

10303737.ch: 你这样打哑谜，可叫人糊涂啊。

10303738.en: She's special. Tianxuan uses her as a weapon against the Mindsnap Temple, and Bitterfly also takes her as someone that can fight against us. If we encounter her shortly after, please follow my words and seize the chance.
10303738.ch: 这个人特殊得很，天玄长老在利用她对付蚀心殿，蝶怨妖妇也利用她对付我们。待会要是发现她了，你听我指示，相机行事便了。

10303739.en: The two leave there in a hurry after a discussion.
10303739.ch: 二人一阵商议后，便匆匆忙忙的离开了。

10303740.en: The wind carries faint voices into your ears. Someone is talking...
10303740.ch: 天风过处，送来絮絮人语之声。

10303742.en: And neither do I. Our elder blamed Bitterfly for taking away the Reunion Circle secretly, and Bitterfly also said that the elder stole the Circle with a trick. The two are in a fierce dispute, and maybe soon they will begin to fight each other.
10303742.ch: 你以为我想？长老指责蝶怨暗中取走道一心环，蝶怨也指责长老使诡计窃得心环，两个争得面红耳赤，肯定要动手了。

10303743.en: When the time comes, I would pick you as my opponent, and then we could engage in a fake fight and fall to the ground as if we really got injured. Deal?
10303743.ch: 到时候我选你作我的对手，你我意思意思，就诈作受伤倒地瞒过旁人，如何？

10303744.en: If only things were as simple as you thought. Our Elder has found the Border Gate and is planning a tactic of luring and surrounding. Now Bitterfly must be trapped in it too.
10303744.ch: 事情没有那么简单，长老查知了那个地方“界门”，到时便是要引你们入瓮，好关门打狗。蝶怨这妖妇这次逃不掉了。

10303745.en: The Border Gate... the one that separates all once closed... So Tianxuan finally found it... No, I don't want to die...
10303745.ch: 界门……就是那个关起门来就可以隔绝一切的……天玄还是找到了……我不想死，我不想死……

10303746.en: The battle at that time must be chaotic, and it must be hard to discern the enemies and the allies. We'll stand close to defend ourselves, and I hope we can survive the fight.
10303746.ch: 到时混战一起，不辨敌我，咱们聚在一处，并力对付来人，希望能够争得一线生机吧。

10303747.en: The voices pause here. Then, you hear steps heading to the east and to the west - the two cultivators have left.
10303747.ch: 只听脚步声起，两人谈话结束，分别向东西两个方向离开了。

10303748.en: {name|B} quivers on hearing these words. Then, she hurries to the two leaders in a desperate fight and takes a stone circle out of her bosom. She hands it to the head of the Taoist Mind Pavilion, and you see the opposite leader immediately answer her action with a heavy blow. {name|B} collapses to the ground and becomes motionless after spitting a mouthful of blood.
10303748.ch: {name|B}闻言一震，然后急步走到正在死斗的双方首领前，后从怀中摸出一枚石环交到道心阁首领手中，另一方首领见状立施重手击倒{name|B}。她似乎受伤十分沉重，喷了口血后，就此匍匐不动。

10303749.en: {name|B} quivers on hearing these words. Then, she hurries to the two leaders in a desperate fight and takes a stone circle out of her bosom. She hands it to the head of the Mindsnap Temple, and you see the opposite leader immediately answer her action with a heavy blow. {name|B} collapses to the ground and becomes motionless after spitting a mouthful of blood.
10303749.ch: {name|B}闻言一震，然后急步走到正在死斗的双方首领前，后从怀中摸出一枚石环交到蚀心殿首领手中，另一方首领见状立施重手击倒{name|B}。她似乎受伤十分沉重，喷了口血后，就此匍匐不动。

10303750.en: I had a narrow escape that day, I think.
10303750.ch: 现在回想起来，当日可真是凶险呢。

10303751.en: Sorry, I feel unwell these days, so I must decline you.
10303751.ch: 抱歉，近日总感觉有些不适，不能答应你的请求了。

10303752.en: Sorry, I always feel dizzy these days. I'm afraid that trying to cultivate under such a condition may not be wise, so could we have a Dual Cultivation later?
10303752.ch: 对不起，这些日子以来总是感觉有些晕眩，强行修炼反而会误事。之后再进行双修，可好？

10303753.en: Thank you, but I have been occupied these days. Maybe we could have a tour later? I am also expecting a joyful day with you.
10303753.ch: 对不起，这些日子较忙，后面我们再约好吗？其实我也很想和你观花赏月，游玩散心呢。

10303754.en: Sorry, my cultivation reaches a crucial point these days, and I'm afraid that a tour with you may distract me.
10303754.ch: 抱歉，近日正是修炼的紧要关头，暂时不能陪你去游玩散心。

10303755.en: Unrestricted energy surges into all directions before you, and in the spot where the flows meet, a person is kneeling on the ground. His hands seem to be caught by the attraction; his forehead is beaded with sweat as he struggles to get himself free from the force.
10303755.ch: 前方灵力散泄，四处奔溢，其中可见劲气交织之处，一人单膝跪倒，双手被吸在地面。其时他正使劲摆脱束缚，挣得满头大汗。

10303756.en: Hey, friend, please help me! I got trapped in the array, and it caught my hands after I touched the ground.
10303756.ch: 喂喂，朋友，帮帮忙行不行？我遭这阵法困住了，手一放这地上面，便再挣脱不开了。

10303757.en: Maybe you'll ridicule me. I found this place strange and decided to inspect it. However, I didn't expect to encounter a seal after a few steps.
10303757.ch: 说来可笑，我发现此地有异，便设法查探，未料该处设有禁制，一来二去，竟着了道儿。

10303758.en: Heh. The truth is that there are mysterious treasures in this place, so I came here.
10303758.ch: 嘿嘿，实不相瞒，此地藏有秘宝，我是为此而来的。

10303759.en: Haha. A righteous person will surely help those who are in need! As for you, my future saver, you must be one of those respectable persons!
10303759.ch: 嘿嘿，拯救受难者难道不是义所当为吗？我观恩人一身正气，岂是唯利是图之辈？

10303761.en: Ah, never mind. I believe my life should be much more expensive. I'll give you a priceless treasure instead, and you will certainly benefit a lot from my gift. What's your opinion?
10303761.ch: 不不不不，我的命还是很贵的。这样吧，我赠你一件无价之宝，你得了以后将有无数好处，你看如何？

10303762.en: Oh! Your perception is so sharp. I have another 10,000 Spirit Stones in hand, you may take them all!
10303762.ch: 哎呦，朋友这双眼睛可真利，什么都瞒不过您。我身上还有一万灵石，这便都给你吧？

10303763.en: My good friend, that's all I can give you. Please save me! I won't last another moment under such an array!
10303763.ch: 朋友，再多我都没有了，求你救救我吧！再迟片刻，我就要被这阵法吞噬了！

10303764.en: Thank you! Thank you very much!

10303766.en: Hey? Are you sure you'll turn away and leave? I'll certainly die! Well? Hey?
10303766.ch: 喂？你见死不救吗？我真会死的，喂？哎？

10303767.en: You walked away. But after a few steps, you hear a slight sound of wind coming from behind. You turn to see its source and find another cultivator. The person is floating in the air, and with a slight gesture, glittering electric arcs emerge between the cultivator's hands.
10303767.ch: 你离开未远，只听身后风声微动，回头看去，一名修仙者于半空中伸手虚按，瞬间聚起无数电光，闪烁出没。

10303770.en: Shameless scum! You broke all the suppressing seals in Hua Feng out of your petty interests! Now, die!
10303770.ch: 无耻之徒，为了一己之私，竟将华封州各处镇煞封印全部破除！真是罪该万死！

10303771.en: With a fierce push from the cultivator's hands, lightning bolts fall on {name|B} and paralyze him. {name|B} is still struggling, but the cultivator captures him with ease and glides away with him on a flying sword.
10303771.ch: 修仙者双手猛的一推，无数电光次第落下，瞬间将{name|B}打成重伤。{name|B}还想挣扎，却被那名修仙者伸手拿下，带着他御剑而去了。

10303773.en: Thank you, my saver. Here, please accept my gratitude.
10303773.ch: 多谢恩人，这是小小心意，请你笑纳。

10303774.en: {name|B} smiles and takes out something exquisite with both hands. However, just as he stretches his arms to give you the gift, dense fog envelops you. After your vision finally cleared, you find {name|B} has already gone.
10303774.ch: {name|B}笑嘻嘻的捧着一件精致的物品送到你面前，未料眼前烟云大起，遮蔽视线。待得雾气消散，{name|B}早已一溜烟的逃开了。

10303775.en: Haha. You saved me, and I will certainly remember such a favor! However, I'm too busy to express my gratitude now. See you! Well, I won't let you down, trust me! I'll bring you a priceless treasure someday!
10303775.ch: 哈哈，救命之恩，在下没齿不忘，但我现在有急事，得先走了，有缘再会！在下不会辜负恩人您的，以后给您送个无价之宝哈！

10303776.en: As for the priceless treasure... I'll remember what I said, but please don't blame me if I really have to break my promise. After all, I'm not certain whether I can get the thing, hahaha!
10303776.ch: 对了，无价之宝的事，我会放在心中的了，但请恩人不要太放在心中！毕竟也不知道拿不拿得到，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

10303777.en: Thank you, my saver! This is all I can give you now, please take it.
10303777.ch: 多谢恩人，这是在下身上全部家当了，请你暂且收下。

10303779.en: My saver, I'll forever remember your kindness in my whole life! However, my pockets are almost empty now, and this is all I can give you. See you!
10303779.ch: 恩人于在下恩同再造，我就牙齿掉光了也不会忘记的。不过现在身上零钱不多，就只要这么点，您请先收下吧。在下先告辞了！

10303780.en: I guess a righteous person should be glad to help others even without any rewards. So maybe you won't be interested in my treasure.
10303780.ch: 恩人一身正气，施恩不望报，岂会稀罕在下的宝物？

10303781.en: But someday I'll certainly bring something valuable to you! Well, someday means I don't know its date. Hahaha.
10303781.ch: 不过在下总有一天我会送你一份大礼的！但是哪一天就说不清了。哈哈哈哈哈。

10303783.en: You noticed a person before you. He is examining the surroundings patiently; his gaze sweeps through the hills and rivers and the nearby terrains. A carefree air lingers on his eyebrows, but sometimes he will pause and get lost in his thoughts. You recognized he is {name|B} you met before.
10303783.ch: 前方一人四处张望，有时眺望远方山水形势，有时俯察身周地理起伏，其人眉宇间略有轻佻之色，但偶尔会透出凝神想象的样子，正是日前所见的{name|B}。

10303784.en: Hey, here you are? Greetings, my friend! I've been keeping you in mind since we parted!
10303784.ch: 咦！怎么是你！嘿嘿，别来无恙吗？那次别后，我一直惦记着你的事情呢？

10303785.en: Well, I am trying to find it as your gift by searching and exploring the land. It is a tiresome work!
10303785.ch: 哎？你看我现在四处勘踏，不就在设法找出那件宝物送给你吗？费了可多心思了！

10303786.en: I haven't found it yet. But just think about it, my saver, such a priceless treasure certainly hides in dangerous places, and I could only manage to get it after much hardship.
10303786.ch: 你看我这不没找着吗？恩人呐，你想想，这种好东西难道那么好得到吗？我不上一下刀山，下一趟火海，能拿到吗？

10303787.en: To be honest, I am also not certain what it is. However, if you know what will you get, the joy of receiving a surprise gift will be lost, right?
10303787.ch: 到底是个什么东西，这可不好说。而且恩人你如今全知道了，日后拿到就没什么惊喜了，对吧？

10303788.en: Okay, okay! You seem to be curious about it, and I'll tell you what you want to know. The truth is that... I don't know what it is.
10303788.ch: 是、是！嘿嘿，恩人可真着急，那我就实说了吧。我也不知道那究竟是个什么东西。

10303789.en: No, I'm always honest! I will never lie to the person who saved my life!
10303789.ch: 不不不！哎呦，瞧您说的？在下岂会欺骗恩人您？

10303790.en: It is a rare treasure, so rare that no one in this world has seen it. And there is no record of it since no one even witnessed it. That's the reason I don't know any of its details.
10303790.ch: 正因那东西十分宝贵，所以八荒之中根本没人见过。没人见过，也就没人记录，我也就无从得知了。

10303791.en: But I'm certain the treasure exists. I guess it may be an extraordinary piece of jade, or it may be planted into soil and grow into something incredible.
10303791.ch: 不过那件东西是的确有的。依我推测，那或者是什么奇特的玉石，将之投入土中，或能长成什么了不得的东西。

10303792.en: And it will also benefit cultivators like us.
10303792.ch: 而此物于我等修仙者，确有不少好处呢。

10303793.en: Hehe. I'm trying to find it now! Would you like to lend me a hand? It would be great if you were willing to assist me in finding the treasure.
10303793.ch: 嘿嘿，我这不是正在找那件宝物吗？或者恩人您助我一臂之力，咱们同心合力，一并将东西找出来，岂不美哉？

10303794.en: Well, maybe my expression misled you, but I don't mean I'm making use of you!
10303794.ch: 不不不！天地良心，我绝对没有这么想！

10303795.en: But you could just think about it. Such a rare treasure must appear in a place with abundant Qi, and there must be other good stuff except for our aim!
10303795.ch: 不过恩人你试想，藏着那宝物的地方必是灵气充沛之地，这种地方一定也有不少好东西呢。

10303796.en: Let's carry out our search together, and once we get good things, you may take half of them as the interest I paid you.
10303796.ch: 咱们一道找那宝物，一道四处探索，得了好东西，咱们两人平分，恩人拿到好东西，权当利息。

10303797.en: And you may as well get your gift, that is, the treasure I am searching for. What's your opinion?
10303797.ch: 到得日后咱们找到了那件好东西，再送给恩人，你看这样好不好？

10303798.en: Hehe, here you are, my saver! We met coincidentally the first time, but I guess a coincidence won't happen twice!
10303798.ch: 嘿嘿，恩人呐，咱们首次相见，那是偶然，咱们这第二回见面可就是缘分了。

10303799.en: Now that we are both here, would you mind lending me a hand? Let's search the nearby terrain and find the treasure I said!
10303799.ch: 既然咱两这么有缘，不如恩人帮我一把好不好？咱们去探索周边找出那件宝物

10303800.en: I won't know when I will get it if you don't help me. It will take... five hundred years? Or one thousand? Hehe.
10303800.ch: 如果没有恩人帮忙，在下还真的拿不准什么时候能找到那宝物呢。也许再找五百年，一千年？嘿嘿

10303801.en: Please kindly offer help, my saver! A genuine treasure must be hard to find, but I'll pay you interest with the good stuff we got on our journey.
10303801.ch: 恩人，帮帮我好吗？你想，真正的宝物有那么容易能到手的？但我可以先给你弄小的，你就当成利息嘛。

10303802.en: Haha, I'll need some time to prepare, so I'll be in Hua Feng for the next few days. You can find me at my residence.
10303802.ch: 嘿嘿，请允许在下准备准备，这些日子我将暂时留在华封州中，恩人稍后可以到我住处寻我。

10303803.en: {name|B}'s dwelling is before you. You always feel an air flow circulating around as if it is protecting the plain house.
10303803.ch: 眼前是{name|B}的住处，你总感觉这附近周围总是萦绕着一股无形气流，像在保护着这个简陋的居所。

10303804.en: Oh, my saver, is there any chance for you to think twice? You may really get something good from searching with me.
10303804.ch: 恩人，不要这么决绝嘛，也许你与我一同探索也能有些喜人的收获呢？

10303805.en: {name|B} is pondering about something in the dwelling; he is stroking his chin with a hand. He smiles as he notices you're here.
10303805.ch: 屋中{name|B}正摸着下巴露出一副竭力思索的样子，但一见你光临住处，立即露出一副欣然之色。

10303806.en: Greetings, my saver! I know you will find me here, and I'm planning to fetch you some little gifts! Finding the treasure is indeed hard, and let's set off for some minor but precious things, okay?
10303806.ch: 哎呦，是恩人！我就知道你会来找我的。因此我早早就在计划去搞些小玩意给你了！左右大宝贝一时半会找不着，咱们就先攒点小宝贝好不好？这就走起好吗？

10303807.en: Come here, please! The place is not far from us, and let's meet there!
10303807.ch: 这边请，就是不远处的地方，咱们到那边去！

10303808.en: Oh, I guess you must be too busy to accept my invitation, right? Never mind! I'll wait for you!
10303808.ch: 恩人贵人事多，暂时没空与我同去吗？没事，我会等你的！

10303809.en: A beautiful village is before you, but the villagers there seem to be worrying something. {name|B}'s conspicuous presence at the village's entrance attracted the villagers' notice.
10303809.ch: 前方乃是一个秀美的村庄，村民无论老幼，均脸带愁容。而{name|B}大咧咧的在村口居中一站，立时引来村民注意。

10303810.en: Tell the village head to meet me here and bring me some good stuff. Hurry up! I don't like to wait.
10303810.ch: 叫村长老头来见我，再给我来点好东西！快快快！时间不等人！

10303811.en: Following these words, an elderly man kneels before him and presses his head down to the ground. Other villagers then hand something precious to {name|B} under the order of the village head.
10303811.ch: {name|B}话一出口，果真有一名老者匍匐倒地，三跪九叩，并命旁人呈上好物，递交他手。

10303812.en: Hey, old man. Any gift for my friend?
10303812.ch: 老头，这是我朋友，也给来点好东西。

10303813.en: After greeting him as an immortal, the village head hurries to ask some other villagers to fetch something.
10303813.ch: 老人三呼仙长，立又喊上几名村人，让其赶紧呈上礼物。

10303814.en: Your gift looks too wretched. I won't be happy if that's what my friend got. Please give us more, okay?
10303814.ch: 老头啊！这些不够啊！这位是我朋友，只给这些太寒碜了！再来点行不行？

10303815.en: The village head could only order his people to prepare more gifts...
10303815.ch: 老人唯唯诺诺，然后又吩咐旁人送来礼物……

10303816.en: That's all? You're certainly not lying to me, right?
10303816.ch: 就只有这么多吗？你可不要蒙我。

10303817.en: The village head replies that this is all they can offer and begs for a pardon.
10303817.ch: 老人又跪地上，只说再都没有了，盼仙长见谅。

10303818.en: Alright! I wish you all a good health. See you again the next time!
10303818.ch: 算了，就这样吧！大家好生珍重，我下次还来！各回各家吧！

10303819.en: The elderly man presses his head several more times before standing up. Then, he leaves with his head drooped.
10303819.ch: 老人跪在地上，恭恭敬敬的又叩了几个头这才低着头站起离开。

10303820.en: Okay. Here are the good stuff we got. You take a half.
10303820.ch: 嘿嘿，东西到手，咱们平分平分，这些给你。

10303821.en: What I am doing is... making good use of them! Haha!
10303821.ch: 做什么？大概是打秋风吧？哈哈！

10303822.en: I mean... Well, it's awkward to find an explanation... It's like wringing something out of them!
10303822.ch: 恩人不知道打秋风是什么意思吗？就是，嘿嘿，害我怪不好意思的，就跟勒索差不多意思嘛！

10303823.en: Hehe, the place holds a secret! Despite the village's tiny size, it is blessed by the earth and produces tasty fruits and rare treasures.
10303823.ch: 嘿嘿，恩人听我细细道来！您别看这个村子小，这里可是个钟灵毓秀之地。村子产有不少嘉果，藏有不少罕有的宝物。

10303824.en: Such an abundance needs to be utilized wisely, so I came there. It would be our fault if we let slip this boon, right? Ahaha.
10303824.ch: 既然他们有那么多好东西，我就来借用借用呗，俗话说“天予不取，反受其咎”，对不对？哈哈。

10303825.en: Oh, I see. If you don't like me to do that, I'll stop then.
10303825.ch: 哦，这样子啊！是，恩人不喜欢，以后我就不来这边打秋风了！

10303826.en: Here, this is a windfall from an exploration before, and I got it by absolutely righteous means. I thought it would be useful to you, please take it.
10303826.ch: 这是不久前在下在外探索时，侥幸获得，绝非“勒索”所得。也是不错的小玩意，请恩人将就收下。

10303827.en: Now we have nothing more to do with the place. Let's go now.

10303828.en: {name|B} waves his hand to you and walks away.
10303828.ch: {name|B}笑嘻嘻的朝你挥了挥手，扬长而去了。

10303829.en: You don't like me to do that? Alright. this is a windfall from an exploration before, and I thought it would be useful to you. I got it by absolutely righteous means, please take it.
10303829.ch: 恩人不喜欢？无妨，这是我不久前在外探索所得，也是不错的小玩意了，这个请恩人收下吧，绝不是“勒索”所得的，哈哈。

10303830.en: {name|B} waves his hand to you. But just when he is about to leave, he seems to remember something and turns back.
10303830.ch: {name|B}微笑着朝你挥了挥手，便要转身离去，不过他突然记起什么似的又回过头来。

10303831.en: My saver, is it possible that the villagers there sent me the gifts out of their own decision? Haha.
10303831.ch: 恩人，有没有想过，也许这村子里的人是心甘情愿将东西送给我的呢？哈哈。

10303832.en: {name|B} bows to you slightly and turns to leave.
10303832.ch: {name|B}说完又朝你轻轻一躬身，这才转身离去。

10303833.en: Hehe. It's not proper to take things from a place too frequently. We should wait some days before the next opportunity comes, right?
10303833.ch: 嘿嘿，这边拿过了不好一直再拿，总得给旁人一个休养生息的机会，恩人说对不对？

10303834.en: Next time we'll go elsewhere for treasures! And here, take this as the interest I paid!
10303834.ch: 下回咱们去别的地方寻宝！这些权当利息，恩人收下吧！

10303835.en: He bids you a goodbye with a smile and leaves.
10303835.ch: 他说完笑着与你别过，这才转身离去。

10303836.en: The village is located amid lush mountains and limpid water. It should be a blessed place, but the people here all look preoccupied.
10303836.ch: 村落依傍于碧山绿水之间，一看而知这是一块福地，然而来往行人，无论老幼均是脸带愁容。

10303837.en: A villager looks at you with a tired expression and says, "Leave here if you don't have urgent matters. Here may be a nice place, but it was cursed by heaven and would bring you bad luck."
10303837.ch: 一名村民看见了你，只是用疲惫的眼神看了看你，然后说道：“没事就离开吧，这里一切都好，唯独受了上苍诅咒，是个不祥之地。”

10303838.en: The villager seems to be helpless and walks away with a heavy sigh.
10303838.ch: 村民似乎十分无奈，深深的叹了口气后便转身离去了。

10303839.en: The village is located amid lush mountains and limpid water. It should be a blessed place, but the villagers here all look preoccupied.
10303839.ch: 村落依傍于碧山绿水之间，一看而知这是一块福地，然而来往村民，无论老幼均是脸带愁容。

10303840.en: {name|B} squats in some distance with a smile. He seems to be arranging something...
10303840.ch: {name|B}笑嘻嘻的蹲坐远方，似乎正在布置什么东西……

10303841.en: Didn't expect to find such a good thing in that tiny village! It is of little use to them, but I would benefit a lot from it!
10303841.ch: 村长老头那小村子里，竟然还有这种好东西，啧啧！这对他们用处不大，对我却是受用无穷！

10303842.en: Hehe! Followed me all the way, right? Now even if you could find the place, you won't notice where I am!
10303842.ch: 嘿嘿！叫你跟着我，这下你就算找到了我，也别想发现我！

10303843.en: {name|B} stands up after a moment. He seems to be feeling satisfied with what he has done and leaves the spot with a joyful smile after brushing the dust from his hands.
10303843.ch: 片刻后，{name|B}直起身来，显出一副大功告成的满意模样，拍掉手中尘埃这才嘿嘿一笑离开了。

10303844.en: Two cultivators before you are maintaining an array under them with energy. They are talking about something...
10303844.ch: 前方两名修仙者释出灵力维护脚底一个法阵，二人一边施法一边说着话……

10303845.en: Destroy the seals in Hua Feng? I'm afraid that we're making a fuss.
10303845.ch: 毁坏华封州封印？我总觉得这事是师兄小题大做了。

10303846.en: I have the same thought. The seals are left by the predecessors in Hua Feng, and it would be difficult for the cultivators here to break them.
10303846.ch: 我也是这么认为的，试想这封印乃是华封州的前辈留下的，州中修士岂能轻易破解？

10303847.en: You have the point, but what if the person decided to destroy them with painstaking effort? Ah, I guess our senior brother would say that to oppose you with a cold face.
10303847.ch: 当然不能轻易破解，但若对方乃是处心积虑的呢？哈哈，我猜师兄会板起脸来这么反驳你。

10303848.en: Perhaps. But now let's get our task done and return to the sect for a rest.
10303848.ch: 也是。赶紧把这边事情解决了，早早回到宗门里歇息吧。

10303849.en: Our senior brother is so troublesome.
10303849.ch: 跟着这么个师兄，可真是叫人不得安生。

10303850.en: The two finished their task as they were talking and left the spot without any delay. All that remains in the wilderness is the trees and the weeds; their leaves rustle in the wind.
10303850.ch: 说话间，二人施法毕了，当即收功远去。茫茫旷野，唯有野草树木，随着天风吹拂，发出沙沙声响。

10303851.en: {name|B} is scanning through the notes in his room. He smiles as he sees you're here.
10303851.ch: {name|B}于房中翻看笔记，他看你来到家中，不禁嘻嘻的露出笑脸来。

10303852.en: Greetings, my saver! Well, I'm planning an exploration in a mystic realm, do you want to go with me?
10303852.ch: 是恩人呐！对了，恩人，在下要去探索秘境，搜寻宝藏，不知恩人可有兴趣一并前往？

10303853.en: Alright, let's go now! We will surely find something valuable!
10303853.ch: 恩人，咱们这就走吧，嘿嘿，包你有所收获。

10303854.en: You seem uninterested in it, right? Don't worry, you may come here anytime and set off an incredible exploration with me once you change your mind.
10303854.ch: 恩人不感兴趣吗？嘿嘿，没事，你若有需要，随时来找我，咱们一同寻幽探秘！

10303855.en: A human-formed monster crawls out from the gloomy forest and lets out gruesome howls. Its strange behavior indicates it has lost its mind.
10303855.ch: 阴森的林木深处，爬出一只人形怪物正嗷嗷的发出怪声，观其行为，怪诞至极，估计已失去神智。

10303857.en: Hearing {name|B}'s voice, the blood puppet becomes frenzied and rushes to you.
10303857.ch: 那只人形血傀听得{name|B}放声说话，狂性大发，发足便朝你等冲来。

10303858.en: No! I tried to speak slightly!

10303859.en: I swear I am not intended... Oh, no! It's here! Fight it first!
10303859.ch: 我对天发誓，不是故意……他来了，他来了！咱们先打！

10303860.en: My apologies, good saver! It's all my fault! You take all the treasure after defeating it, okay? It's my fault!
10303860.ch: 恩人，对不起！都是在下不好，打败它后，所得宝藏全部归你，我错了！我错了！

10303861.en: The blood puppet has been wounded seriously. Now it lies on the ground and cannot move again.
10303861.ch: 血傀受到重创，匍匐地上，已无法行动。

10303862.en: The blood puppet got Qi deviated and is no longer a human being. Should I end its misery?
10303862.ch: 血傀发狂入魔，沦为怪物，已非常人，我帮他解脱了吧？

10303863.en: Okay! You're so kind, and let's take the treasure and go!
10303863.ch: 是！恩人好心肠，我们拿过宝物这便走吧！

10303864.en: Alright! You take the treasure and leave here, I'll deal with other matters!
10303864.ch: 好的！恩人拿走宝物，先走吧。剩下的我来处理便好！

10303865.en: The blood puppet has been wounded seriously and could only be wriggling forward on the ground. {name|B} follows it with slow paces, and after his enemy used up all its strength, he steps to it and begins to speak with a smile.
10303865.ch: 血傀身负重创，正在地上爬行挣扎。{name|B}在后慢步跟着，待其无力爬行，这才笑眯眯的站定打量面前血傀。

10303866.en: I have thought about sparing you, but you have the thing that will counter the monster, which is a reason to take your life. Fine! At least your misery will end today.
10303866.ch: 原本可以免你一死的。只可惜，你身上带着克制妖物的东西，这就由不得你苟延残喘。嗯，左右你都生不如死了，不如就此解脱吧。

10303867.en: A fierce glance flicks through {name|B}'s eyes as he strikes his enemy's vital part. The blood puppet becomes immobile after a brief spasm, and {name|B} bends down to search for something on it before leaving.
10303867.ch: {name|B}笑眯眯的脸上闪出杀机，同时出手击中血傀弱点，那怪物颤抖两下，终于静止不动。{name|B}俯身在血傀身上搜了一搜，然后转头去了。

10303869.en: I'm sorry to tell you that you are already dead. Existing as a mindless monster must be boring, right?
10303869.ch: 对不起，你早死透了，像这样行尸走肉，也没多大意思不是？

10303870.en: Just an instant... It won't be too painful. Hehe.
10303870.ch: 就一下子，不会痛的……嘿嘿。

10303873.en: Who do you think would be the persons destroying the seals this time?
10303873.ch: 你说此次破坏封印的究竟是些什么人？

10303874.en: Persons? Maybe there is only one person. Our senior brother has found the person and is following our target.
10303874.ch: 些？恐怕只有一个人。师兄到已经找到那个人的踪迹，而且一直追踪呢。

10303875.en: Ehehe. Sounds like a covert contest between them! Who will win in your eyes?
10303875.ch: 嘿嘿，那这两人不是在暗中斗法了？你说谁会赢？

10303876.en: Hey, do you want our senior brother to lose?
10303876.ch: 呸，你还会盼着师兄输吗？

10303877.en: Well, I didn't say that. All I want is to finish our annoying task as soon as possible and go back to our sect to deal with our own matters.
10303877.ch: 喂喂，我可没这么说。我呢，只想着赶紧把这破事做完，回到宗门做自己的事。

10303879.en: You enter {name|B}'s room, but he is not here. There are only bamboo slips and books on the desk.
10303879.ch: 你来到{name|B}屋中，却发现里面空无一人，只有案上摆放着竹简书籍。

10303880.en: You scan through the records written in tiny fonts and find that they are all studies on an unknown treasure.
10303880.ch: 竹简书籍上记录大片蝇头小字，稍作浏览，发现都是对某一异宝的研究。

10303881.en:
It is buried deeply underground and draws the essence from the earth to maintain its life.
One should cut its channel to the earth's essence to get it.
But once it is dug out for no reason, it will draw the life essence from the digger.
So as to kill those who excavated it and gain energy to survive.
10303881.ch:
异宝深埋地底，借此吸纳地气，以供生存。
要想设法获得，则需截断地气供给。
若秘宝被无故起出，则会吸纳挖掘者本身寿元。
借此杀死挖掘者并获取维持自身生命的灵力。

10303882.en:
Once the treasure draws the life essence from human beings, it will undergo a thorough transformation into a genuine spiritual root.
It will live on its own after that and no longer needs to draw essence from outside.
The key point is to facilitate its transformation with the energy inside cultivators.
It may both benefit and harm persons a lot.
10303882.ch:
秘宝一旦吸纳旁人精气寿元后即发生质变，并因此成为真正的灵根。
此时秘宝生机自给自足，不需再假他求。
关键处乃借修仙者体内灵力促成秘宝成为完整之姿态。
此物既有大利，亦有大害。

10303883.en: But once it is dug out for no reason, it will draw the life essence from the digger.
10303883.ch: 若秘宝被无故起出，则会吸纳挖掘者本身寿元。

10303884.en: So as to kill those who excavated it and gain energy to survive.
10303884.ch: 借此杀死挖掘者并获取维持自身生命的灵力。

10303885.en: Once the treasure draws the life essence from human beings, it will undergo a thorough transformation into a genuine spiritual root.
10303885.ch: 秘宝一旦吸纳旁人精气寿元后即发生质变，并因此成为真正的灵根。

10303886.en: It will live on its own after that and no longer needs to draw essence from outside.
10303886.ch: 此时秘宝生机自给自足，不需再假他求。

10303887.en: The key point is to facilitate its transformation with the energy inside cultivators.
10303887.ch: 关键处乃借修仙者体内灵力促成秘宝成为完整之姿态。

10303888.en: It may both benefit and harm persons a lot.
10303888.ch: 此物既有大利，亦有大害。

10303889.en: You try to peruse them, but {name|B} rushes into the room at this moment. He seems to be astonished by what he saw, but a bright smile emerges again as he looks at you the next instant.
10303889.ch: 还待细看，此时{name|B}闯入屋中，他进门之际讶色一闪而没，然后满脸堆欢的看着你。

10303890.en: Here you are, my saver? Are you here for another exploration? I found an unknown site these days, and let's go now!
10303890.ch: 恩人，你来了啊？想必你是来找我外出探宝的吧？正好，我探明一处地点，咱们快去探索一下！

10303891.en: Just as you are about to leave, {name|B} rushes into the room. He looks to the desk and the pile of bamboo slips and books first, then turns to you with a bright smile.
10303891.ch: 你正待离去，{name|B}突然闯入屋中，他眼神瞄向屋中放满竹简书籍的案台，然后才满脸堆欢的看着你。

10303892.en: Greetings, my saver! What about another exploration now? I found an unknown site these days!
10303892.ch: 哎呦，是恩人呐！走，我们去探索宝物，我查明一处地点，这就出发去探索探索！

10303894.en: Oh, I see. Remember to find me here if you have any spare time!
10303894.ch: 哦，恩人不想来，我也不好勉强。等你有空了，再来找我吧！

10303895.en: Places holding treasures are mostly brimmed with Qi. However, the abundant Qi in these places will easily attract monsters. Should we enter into there now?
10303895.ch: 自来藏纳宝物之处，多为灵气逼人之地。这种地方也容易成为妖兽盘踞之地。咱们现在要进去吗？

10303897.en: As you go deeper, monsters emerge from the shadows. {name|B} charges forward, only to retreat in terror moments later, his clothes ablaze from the monsters' fiery breath.
10303897.ch: 随着你们深入，里面涌出大量妖兽，{name|B}率先冲入应战，但只眨眼间就被妖兽口喷烈焰弄得满身是火，大呼小叫地跑了开去。

10303898.en: Ouch, it hurts! The fire got my...
10303898.ch: 好烫好烫！烧到、烧到那啥了！

10303899.en: My saver, I wanted to shield you from the monster's flame, so...
10303899.ch: 恩人，我看这妖兽不怀好意，要喷火烧你这才为你挡下的！

10303902.en: You defeat the monsters and find {name|B} cowering in a corner, covered in dirt. He humbly offers a small pile of valuables and collapses to the ground.
10303902.ch: 你才将妖兽尽数打败，{name|B}便灰头土脸的不知从哪跑了出来。他捧着若干宝物递到你面前后，便一把扑倒地上，动弹不得。

10303903.en: That's all I can get, my saver! I found these from inside... The interest I paid...
10303903.ch: 恩人，在下尽力了！这些都是从里面找到的好东西……权当利息……

10303904.en: {name|B}'s head hangs low, but the rise and fall of his chest reveals that he's still alive...
10303904.ch: {name|B}说着头一垂下便不动了，但可看见他胸口起伏，仍在呼吸……

10303905.en: Okay, okay! It's a good place, right?
10303905.ch: 咳咳！好吧！这地儿挺人杰地灵的，对吗？

10303906.en: Well, no. I'll catch cold if I lie here. Time to go!
10303906.ch: 不不不，躺多了容易着凉，咱们走，咱们走！

10303907.en: My saver, now you see! I said that tagging along with me... eh, exploring the realms with me, will bring you good stuff!
10303907.ch: 恩人，跟着我混，不对，和我一起探寻秘境，收获不错吧？

10303908.en: Oh, it's a tiny object. I tried hard to find it, but I only get some pieces of clue now.
10303908.ch: 哦，那是一个小东西，我费了很大心力还没找到，只找到若干线索。

10303909.en: The records you saw had been paraphrased many times before I found them, and I'm not certain whether the treasure will harm people. If they are still reliable, then according to them, I will pay a huge price to get what I'm searching for, which I thought was unworthy.
10303909.ch: 这些资料几经周转来到我手中，已经变得真伪难辨了，有无害处还真不好说。若我所得信息为真，取得这东西代价也太大了，不值得。

10303910.en: No, I swear I didn't plan it! I also had a tough battle inside. Just look at these wounds!
10303910.ch: 天地良心，绝无此事！我在更里面的地方也是杀得昏天黑地呢！你看我身上四处挂彩了！

10303911.en: It's so delightful to explore the mystic realm together with you! I'll try to find more sites and carry out more explorations, so please remember to visit my dwelling often!
10303911.ch: 能和恩人一并探索秘境，真让人感到不胜欣喜呢！我还会继续找到这附近值得探索的地方的，恩人还请多多光临寒舍！

10303912.en: You spot a cultivator near {name|B}'s residence, scanning the area as if searching for something.
10303912.ch: 只见{name|B}住处附近有一名修仙者正立于旷野之中四处张望，似乎正在寻找什么。

10303913.en: It seems that my chasing has been noticed by such a sly target. We should seize the person right now, or Hua Feng would be in peril...
10303913.ch: 那家伙果然十分警惕，看来已经察觉了我的追踪了。得赶紧拿下此人，否则华封州危矣……

10303914.en: The cultivator notices you, but he walks away after looking at you for a while.
10303914.ch: 那名修仙者发现你的存在，但他细细打量你一阵后，便转头离开了。

10303916.en: You enter {name|B}'s room, but he is not here. There is only a letter and a casket containing something before you.
10303916.ch: 你进入{name|B}住处，里面空无一人，但当眼处放着一张留书，旁边放着一个小盒，似乎装有物品。

10303917.en:
My saver, I will go for another exploration now. These are some precious things I found recently, please take them.
I'll return in a few days, and let's set off for another journey when we meet again!
Of course, I always remember what I promised you, and all you receive now is the interest I paid!
10303917.ch:
恩人，我到外面探索宝物了。这是近日探得的一点小玩意，请你取走。
不日就即回归，到时仍与恩人一并闯荡，发掘宝物！
当然，答应你的大宝贝，我时刻记在心中的！这些只是利息，是利息！

10303918.en: I'll return in a few days, and let's set off for another journey when we meet again!
10303918.ch: 不日就即回归，到时仍与恩人一并闯荡，发掘宝物！

10303919.en: Of course, I always remember what I promised you, and all you received now is the interest I paid!
10303919.ch: 当然，答应你的大宝贝，我时刻记在心中的！这些只是利息，是利息！

10303920.en: Since {name|B} is out for exploration and will not be back recently, you leave the place.
10303920.ch: {name|B}不在家中，多留无用。故此你离开了此地。

10303921.en: You see {name|B} breaks a seal under him with energy and sighs slightly.
10303921.ch: 只见{name|B}施法释出灵力，将脚下一出封印解除，然后轻轻吁了口气。

10303922.en: Heck! Did they deliberately set this trap, knowing I would be here?
10303922.ch: 可恶，这家伙料定我会来到此处，故意设下禁止算计我吗！

10303923.ch: 咦！这不是恩人吗？恩人你好，恩人你好！

10303924.en: Ah, I just stepped on a seal! Well, this time I can get out of it on my own and no need to be saved again! See, I have already broken it!
10303924.ch: 嘿嘿，就是不小心踩到一处封印上了！嘿嘿，不过这回不用劳烦恩人搭救，我已经自己解除了封印了！

10303925.en: {name|B} has a brief and careless talking with you and hurries away...
10303925.ch: {name|B}与你点头哈腰的说了两句，匆匆忙忙的就走了……

10303927.en: Greetings, my saver! I was out for some matters the last time and could not engage in an exploration with you. But let's set off now!
10303927.ch: 恩人，你来了呀，真抱歉呢，上回在外忙乎，没能与你一同外出探索。走，咱们出去走走！

10303929.ch: 好，恩人不想外出，咱们就不去！

10303930.en: {name|B} seems preoccupied, his usual cheerful demeanor replaced by a tired expression. Upon his arrival at the mystic realm, he remains silent and lost in thought.
10303930.ch: 来到目的地后，只见一向笑嘻嘻的{name|B}变得沉默寡言，只是带着疲惫的神色不言声的在秘境中四处查探。

10303931.en: Ah, here they are. Please take a look, my saver, these things are also precious.
10303931.ch: 啊，找到了。恩人请看，这些小玩意也都不错的。

10303932.en: I feel a bit tired. There are always so many things to do, and I fail to reach my target many times. It really frustrates me.
10303932.ch: 只是有点累罢了。要做的事似乎总是做不完，订下的目标也总是无法达到。每次想到这些，心里都会很气馁。

10303933.en: Thanks for considering me, my saver. However, I won't let myself wait even if you allow me to do so. Please trust me.
10303933.ch: 啧啧，恩人可真是体贴。不过即使恩人予以宽限，在下也不会宽限自己的，放心吧！

10303934.en: I see, I see. I'll soon bring you the thing I promised.
10303934.ch: 是的是的，答应恩人的事我会尽快兑现的。

10303935.en: Have I... misheard your words? Are you trying to encourage me?
10303935.ch: 我……我没听错吧？恩人竟鼓励在下？

10303936.en: To be honest, I also want to have a rest, but my mind urges me to pursue my goal. Whenever I noticed it, I would always think of you. Maybe I have already given up if you were not at my side.
10303936.ch: 其实……我也是盼着休息一下，但心里总平静不下来。我每次都会想如非有恩人陪同，可能我早就放弃了吧？

10303937.en: Or should I just let things be? I've had them enough, and maybe it would be better to stop. However, my mind will be tortured by regret if I really give up.
10303937.ch: 怎么样都好，我已经受够了……真想就这么罢手算了。可是，尽管如此，我还是明白即使罢手我也是无法获得心中的平静的。

10303939.en: {name|B} pauses suddenly. He seems to be feeling his words are confusing and can only grin with an awkward smile. Then he puts the treasures he found into your hands.
10303939.ch: {name|B}突然一愣，他似乎发现自己说了多余的话，便又无奈笑笑，将探得的宝物交到你手。

10303940.en: Take them, my saver. We've found all notable things here, and let's go now.
10303940.ch: 恩人，这些给你。此地已无可继续探索的东西。走吧。

10303941.en: {name|B} hands you the treasures and turns to look into the distance. A slight smile appears on his weary face, and he seems to gain strength after such a brief respite.
10303941.ch: {name|B}将宝物交给你后便转过头看着远方，他原本疲惫的脸上透出一丝笑意。就这么片刻间，他似乎恢复了精神。

10303942.en: Let's go, my saver. There is nothing to be inspected here.
10303942.ch: 恩人，走吧，这边已经没什么值得继续查探的了。

10303943.en: {name|B} stands on a hill's top and is gazing into the horizon. You look at him from a distance and notice his worried expression. Maybe something is troubling him.
10303943.ch: {name|B}默默站在远方山丘之上眺望远处。极目看去，可见他面目愁烦，似为心事所困。

10303944.en: My brother... Am I wrong? Maybe it is indeed a bad decision, or why do they try to prevent me at all costs?
10303944.ch: 大哥……我做错了吗？可能我的确做了个不好的决定呢，不然他们为什么全力阻止我呢？

10303945.en: But I reassure you, I'll find the thing no matter how much it will cost. It's your wish, as well as mine...
10303945.ch: 不过无论如何，我也会把那件东西找出来的，那是你的心愿，也是我的心愿……

10303946.ch: {name|B}长长的叹了一口气，便转身离开了。

10303947.en: {name|B} pores over the books on his desk, deep in contemplation. However, his familiar smile returns as he turns to you.
10303947.ch: {name|B}脸色凝重，正在研读案上书籍。但他察觉到你的到访后，却又笑眯眯的朝你看来。

10303948.en: Hey, you're here, and let's go for an exploration! I found another mystic realm with treasures!
10303948.ch: 是恩人呐！走走走！我又找到一处藏有宝物的秘境，咱们去碰碰运气！

10303949.en: My saver, let's set off now! Or I'm afraid that some lucky cultivator will bump into there and take all the treasures away!
10303949.ch: 恩人，咱们出发吧，不然被哪个撞了狗屎运的修仙者歪打正着拿了里面的东西可就亏大了！

10303950.en: Okay, we won't go if you're not interested!
10303950.ch: 好，恩人不感兴趣，咱们就不去！

10303951.en: My saver, here is the place I said. Should we venture into it now?
10303951.ch: 恩人，就是这里了，咱们要进去吗？

10303952.en: Hehe! I'll go for a reconnaissance, please wait for me here. Monsters may lurk in such a desolated wilderness, so we must be careful!
10303952.ch: 嘿嘿，恩人，我先去探路，你请稍等。山泽荒野，多为妖兽潜藏之地，咱们需要小心谨慎！

10303953.en: {name|B} speaks with a serious expression, but then he smiles again. He hurries away without looking back.
10303953.ch: {name|B}一脸郑重的将话说完，然后露出笑嘻嘻的样子，一溜烟的走了。

10303954.en: Just as he vanishes into the distance, ominous howls pierce the air. You turn to see a horde of monsters closing in.
10303954.ch: 然而他身影才刚消失，背后妖物低吼之声便次第响起，回头看去，若干妖兽早已围住了你……

10303955.en: Hey there, my saver! We do not need to fight this time, since I sneaked into it and snatched all the treasures! Look at them!
10303955.ch: 恩人，恩人，这回咱们不需动手了，我偷偷溜进去，将宝物统统拿出来了！你看你看！

10303956.en: Well? I didn't expect there to be monsters as well. Let's leave here before they wake up again!
10303956.ch: 咦，原来这里还有，咱们乘它们倒下没醒，赶紧走人吧！

10303957.en: Ah, awesome! My saver defeated all the monsters and made Hua Feng a safer place! Here, these vials are from my private collection, please take them as well!
10303957.ch: 哎呦，恩人真的厉害，一个人把这些妖兽全消灭了，为华封州安宁作贡献了啊！来来来，我这里还有几瓶私藏的好东西，一并送你吧！

10303958.en: Let's leave here! We've got all the good stuff in this place.
10303958.ch: 这边没什么好东西了，咱们走吧！

10303959.en: My saver, you seem to be grudging. Do you feel that the treasure here is too inferior? My apologies, the next time I'll bring you better ones.
10303959.ch: 恩人，怎么好像一脸不满的样子，是这里的宝物不够好吗？这次先这样好吗？我下次再给您找更好的。

10303960.en: My saver, you must be very tired after days of exploration. Should we leave here for a good rest?
10303960.ch: 恩人，劳顿半日，这就离开好好休息整顿一下吧？

10303961.en: {name|B} is standing silently with his head drooped. His usual smile has gone; a solemn expression is on his lowered face.
10303961.ch: {name|B}垂首默立，他一改往日笑嘻嘻的模样，显得十分沉重。

10303962.en: My brother, I'm very close to success. I will find the treasure to make your wish come true.
10303962.ch: 大哥，就差一点，我一定会找到那件秘宝，完成你的心愿的。

10303964.en: {name|B} stands there motionlessly, but you hear two drops fall on the grass leaves before him.
10303964.ch: {name|B}站立如故，但听滴答两声轻响，两滴水珠落在他身前，濡湿地上草叶。

10303965.en: {name|B} is not in his dwelling, and the desk and chairs in the room are all covered by a thin layer of dust. It seems that he has been out for some days, and you could only come here later for a visit.
10303965.ch: {name|B}住处空无一人，几案桌椅均落着一层薄薄的尘埃，看来人已离开一段时间，只能过些时日再来造访。

10303967.en: Hey, did you know that? Our senior brother caught him.
10303967.ch: 喂，你知道吗？师兄逮到那家伙了。

10303968.en: The person has been caught? Then why are we still going out for our task here?
10303968.ch: 逮到了？那我们还在这边干嘛？

10303969.en: Our senior brother only had a fight with him, but the person escaped in the end.
10303969.ch: 师兄只是跟这人照面交手了，最后还是被那家伙脚底抹油溜之大吉了。

10303970.en: By the way, which of them is more powerful?
10303970.ch: 话说，这两人打起来谁比较厉害一些？

10303971.en: Maybe our senior brother. He gained some advantage in the fight.

10303972.en: Hmph, as I expected. Such a scum won't even be a fit opponent for our senior brother.
10303972.ch: 哼，我就知道。这种宵小之辈，哪能是师兄的对手？

10303973.en: But we shouldn't underestimate him since we got duped by him and ran everywhere aimlessly for that. Now let's go! I finished the inspection here.
10303973.ch: 你别小看这家伙，他不就将你我搞得昏头转向疲于奔命吗？走吧，此处查探完了。

10303974.en: The two leave the spot after the brief talk. There is no other sound except for the howling wind sweeping through the wilderness.
10303974.ch: 两人说完转身离去，旷野之中除却风声虎虎，更无人语之声。

10303975.en: Something high above glides through the air. It's a cultivator riding on a flying sword and is heading in the direction of {name|B}'s dwelling.
10303975.ch: 高空处掠影闪过，一人御剑去远，飞往{name|B}住处方向。

10303977.en: You come to {name|B}'s dwelling and notice a cultivator inspecting the surroundings outside. He becomes alert as he sees you.
10303977.ch: 你来到{name|B}住处，只见一名修仙者在其住处外来回巡查，他看见你后不禁露出警惕的神色。

10303978.en: He looks at you with sharp, cold eyes. But he nods after a while; he seems to have let his guard down.
10303978.ch: 面前之人眼神变得十分锐利，他打量你一阵后略一点头，似乎放松了警惕。

10303979.en: Well, you're not the one who lived here. I'm inspecting a strange thing and following the traces here. Then, after I finally broke the seal in this place with much effort, I couldn't enter the house as well.
10303979.ch: 嗯，你不是此处主人。我正查探一件怪事，然后跟随蛛丝马迹来到此处。再费了好大一番功夫这才破解了这个住处的封印，结果仍然无法进入眼前这座宅子。

10303980.en: Hmph. The seal seems to be set specifically against me.
10303980.ch: 哼，此处主人似乎是针对我设下的禁制呢。

10303981.en: It's more crucial than strange, for it will pose a threat to Hua Feng. I noticed someone who keeps breaking the seals suppressing the monster in Hua Feng recently.
10303981.ch: 与其说这是一件怪事，毋宁说这是一件关乎华封州安危的大事。我发现近日有人接连破解几个镇压华封州妖兽的封印。

10303982.en: These seals are set to confine the monster. Once they are broken, the monster will be able to move freely.
10303982.ch: 这些封印用于困住一只妖兽的，一旦全部破解，那牵制妖兽的枷锁也就不复存在了。

10303983.en: Hua Feng will be in peril once the monster has been released. And I came here to investigate the matter.
10303983.ch: 妖兽一旦复出，势必会让华封州遭受损害。而我正是为此来到此处查明一切。

10303984.en: Fellow cultivator, if you notice someone looking for mystic realms around here, please remember to inform me. Such a person may not be an ordinary treasure hunter.
10303984.ch: 道友，若你看见附近有什么人在四处查找秘境，请一定要告诉我，那人很可能并非一般堪舆寻宝之人。

10303985.en: That person's action will probably put Hua Feng in danger.
10303985.ch: 此人很可能会做出不利于华封州的事。

10303986.en: This cultivator looks worried. He looks at the house before him with a frown and leaves the spot.
10303986.ch: 这名修仙者脸现凝重之色，他看了看眼前居所皱了皱眉，这才离开了。

10303987.en: It seems that many clues are hiding in {name|B}'s dwelling. A thorough investigation may yield some findings.
10303987.ch: {name|B}家中似乎藏有许多线索，彻查一番也许能有收获。

10303988.en: There is no one in {name|B}'s dwelling, and bamboo slips, books, and handwritten pages still pile on the desk.
10303988.ch: {name|B}的住处空无一人，案桌上依然放着无数竹简书籍、手写文书。

10303989.en: The record on the slips is written with arcane words. It is hard to fully understand it, but you know it is about a treasure called the Illusion Root.
10303989.ch: 竹简之中的文辞十分古奥，乍看下并不十分明白，但大约可知记录的是一件叫作“九幻灵根”的秘宝。

10303990.en: The books are mostly records of the seals of monsters and the exploration into various mystic realms. It seems that {name|B} has done thorough research on how to break the seals.
10303990.ch: 你查看案上书籍，大都是关于妖兽封印、以及各种秘境的探索方式的记载。看来{name|B}正处心积虑要解开妖兽封印。

10303991.en: There is a thin notebook on the desk. It is full of handwritten records, and you even find {name|B}'s notes on his experience in the past at the beginning of the notebook.
10303991.ch: 你查看书案，你发现一本薄薄的册子，上面都是人手写就的各种记录，开始数页更有{name|B}早年的经历。

10303992.en: Should I find {name|B} and ask him all the questions?
10303992.ch: 我要不要找{name|B}当面问个明白？

10303993.en: Indeed. Now I need a clarification made by him.

10303994.en: Maybe it's not proper for me to intervene in it.

10303995.en: I tried hard these years without a moment of rest. However, all of the things surrounding me are reminders of such a treasure, urging me to find it.
10303995.ch: 这些年来我一直在努力，没有一丝懈怠。但即使如此，身边的一切似乎都在提醒着我一定要找到那件物品。

10303996.en: To be honest, I do not need any reminders. I always remember what happened in the past... Even now, those memories are still vivid and clear like something inscribed in my mind.
10303996.ch: 其实那时候的事情一直让我魂牵梦绕，根本不需要提醒，我忘不了……那些往事都像当下发生的一样，清晰、明白、深印脑海之中……

10303997.en: These pages are a detailed record of someone's experience and are filled with sorrow and disappointment.
10303997.ch: 文书之中记录大量书写者的经历，当中不乏心酸与失望之情。

10303998.en: A cultivator was trapped in an array; his hands were confined on the ground and could not be lifted up.
10303998.ch: 一名修仙者被阵法困住，他一双肉掌牢牢贴在地上无法抽起。

10303999.en: I'm too careless! Will I end up dead here today?
10303999.ch: 大意了，今日要交代在这了吗？

10304001.en: Another cultivator activated a spell at some distance and solved the array gradually. The trapped cultivator leaped out from the ground at once. He was panting due to the excessive usage of his energy, but the cultivator who saved him only looked at him with a smile.
10304001.ch: 来人隔空施法，逐渐解开阵法束缚，那名修仙者得此良机，立即闪身离开。他连番催动灵力，身体损耗巨大，禁不住呼呼喘气，来人却只是笑眯眯的看着他。

10304002.en: People say you are an expert in exploring mystic realms and digging for treasures, and that you will reach your goal once you make one. However, I guess it would be a pity for you if you wasted your talent on that meager stuff.
10304002.ch: 传闻说你善于探寻秘境，挖掘宝物。大家都说你只要定下目标，总要完成。但如说你的目标只是眼前这些一般宝物，对于你这份才能是不是有点浪费了呢？

10304003.en: I need you to find something for me. Give me your price.
10304003.ch: 我需要你帮忙找个东西，你开个条件。

10304004.en: No need to say that. I'll help you as a repayment for saving my life.
10304004.ch: 不必了。我会帮你的，算是回报你救命之恩。

10304005.en: Oh? You know what it means.

10304006.en: My brother, I said I won't forget your favor of saving my life, but... I'm afraid that the thing you are searching for has cost you too much...
10304006.ch: 大哥，你的救命之恩，我永不敢忘，可是……可是你为了这东西已经耗费太多心力了……

10304007.en: In fact, I'm not really craving for its power. But after such a long journey, I need to find it with my own hands as a piece of evidence for the huge effort I made. And why do you say that? Does it mean you won't help me from now on?
10304007.ch: 其实大哥也不是真的觊觎那玩意，只是一路走来，耗费了许多精力，只想亲手找到那东西给自己一个交代罢了。怎么？你不帮我了？

10304008.en: I have no such meaning. I'll follow your instructions as usual. I'm just worrying about you.
10304008.ch: 不，大哥说做什么，我就做什么。我只是担心你。

10304009.en: Follow my instructions as usual... But why would you do that, my brother?
10304009.ch: 我说什么，你就做什么……兄弟，这到底是为了什么？

10304011.en: I could guess something from your silence. Do you want to express your gratitude for being saved? Or do you want to reassure your sworn brother? If someone saves you again in the future and you two become friends, you may suffer losses if you are so grateful.
10304011.ch: 你不说我也知道，是救命之恩，还是结义之情？倘若以后再有个人救你一命，跟你结下友谊，你岂非很吃亏？

10304012.en: Ehehe. It may be hard to befriend me since I always do some not-so-good things similar to pilfering.
10304012.ch: 嘿嘿，要和我这样的人结下友谊，其实还不太容易，毕竟我做的事，总是跟偷鸡摸狗有点挂钩的。

10304013.en: If someone treated me like that, I'd be happy to return the favor. But no one ever has.
10304013.ch: 倘若真有人愿意像大哥这样对待我，我也是会全力报答他的。不过我看没有这样的人。

10304014.en: You look clever, but in my eyes, you are actually silly. I'm afraid that someone will take advantage of you in the future.
10304014.ch: 我看你长了一副聪明面相，没想到却是一个笨蛋，这样你往后会很吃亏的。

10304015.en: If you feel you have done all you could do, you may leave here, and I won't blame you...
10304015.ch: 你觉得无能为力了，就走吧。大哥不怪你……

10304017.en: The cultivator was shaking his sworn brother's shoulders.
10304017.ch: 修仙者摇了摇义兄的肩膀

10304018.en: Are you feeling well, my brother?

10304019.en: I... will find the Illusion Root... I will!
10304019.ch: 我……我一定要找到……找到九幻灵根！

10304020.en: My brother, maybe you should give up the thought and stop! You are now obsessed with it, and the aimless searching has consumed you too much energy...
10304020.ch: 大哥，这事就此作罢好吗？不能再找了，大哥你已经深陷其中，你耗费的心力已经太多了……

10304021.en: But even a peak needs time to grow, and failing at the last step would be unacceptable!
10304021.ch: 为山九仞，岂可功亏一篑？

10304022.en: Good brother, you will be burned out if you keep to do so...
10304022.ch: 大哥，再这么下去你会垮掉的……

10304023.en: Are you dissuading me? Go away from me!
10304023.ch: 你走开，说什么泄气话？走开！

10304025.en: The cultivator kneeled on the ground and was weeping in grief. His sworn brother lay before him, a stream of blood flowing down from his mouth corner. He cast the cultivator a dull look, but his eyes glimmered faintly.
10304025.ch: 修仙者跪在地上，泪下如雨。他的义兄横躺前面，嘴角流血无精打采的看着他。但那双疲惫无奈的眼中却迸发出一丝光芒。

10304026.en: Did I get it wrong? Such a treasure doesn't exist, right?
10304026.ch: 你说，我错了吗？那东西是没有的，是吗？

10304027.en: No! Brother, what you did is right. It's me that to be blamed, for I failed to find the treasure for you.
10304027.ch: 不！大哥没错，错的是我，我没有帮你找到异宝。

10304028.en: I heard your words. But I guess what you really want to say is, I should try to dissuade my sworn brother from the beginning.
10304028.ch: 你嘴里这样说，心里想的却是：我应该早早劝大哥放弃此事。

10304029.en: Don't blame yourself, that's my fate. I should have listened to you back then.
10304029.ch: 不要自责，这都是命。当初，大哥应该听你劝的。

10304030.en: My life will soon end, but I'm worrying you... Good brother, others may as well do you a favor in the future, but maybe you could avoid feeling beholden to them...
10304030.ch: 大哥要走了，可是我不放心……兄弟，以后但凡谁对你有恩，你不可再老想着傻傻的去回报了……

10304031.en: The sworn brother's eyes suddenly lost focus. An extraordinary joy shined in his eyes as if he was surrounded by wonderful things.
10304031.ch: 义兄的眼神突然迷离起来，他双眼透出喜悦，似乎眼前所见尽是一片美好。

10304032.en: There, brother, the Illusion Root! I got it! See? I got it!
10304032.ch: 九幻灵根！我终于找到了！兄弟，你看！我找到了！

10304034.en: The man became stiff and motionless with his last words. The cultivator burst into tears upon seeing that; he didn't expect that the glimmer in his brother's eyes was the last spark of his life.
10304034.ch: 话说完，他的身体就僵直不动了。修仙者嚎啕大哭，他不曾想过刚刚义兄眼中的神采竟是他体内生命迸发出的最后一丝光芒。

10304035.en: I reassure you, my brother, I'll finish what you failed to do! I'll make it!
10304035.ch: 大哥放心，没能完成的，兄弟都给你完成。这一切都交给我好了。

10304036.en: You step into a wilderness and find cultivators fallen on the ground. Judging from the dead monsters in some distance, there must have been a fierce fight shortly before. Two distant voices come to you with the wind.
10304036.ch: 你来到一处旷野，发现周围若干修仙者一动不动倒伏地上，不远处妖兽尸体横陈地面，可以想象当时此处双方一定发生了一场激战。旷野凉风，送来远处人语之声。

10304037.en: Senior brother, why would such a monster be here? It was sealed deep underground.
10304037.ch: 师兄，妖兽明明被封存地底，为何会无端出世？

10304040.en: When we surrounded the monster that day, the person also joined us in the fight. He was badly wounded but left there.
10304040.ch: 当日围剿妖兽之际，此人亦加入战团一同协助击杀妖兽。最终此人身负重伤而去。

10304041.en: That sounds ridiculous. Why did he join the fight against the monster after releasing it?
10304041.ch: 岂有此理，此人放出妖兽，为何又参与围剿？

10304042.en: I don't know. Our sect suffered causalities due to him, and by doing that, he also put Hua Feng in danger. He must be eliminated.
10304042.ch: 我不知道，此人累我门人损兵折将，又让华封州陷入危机，实是罪不容诛。

10304043.en: Yes, senior brother! Let's find him and revenge our sect members!
10304043.ch: 师兄说得是，我们这便赶紧找到此人，将其击杀，好报仇雪恨！

10304044.en: The two walk away as they are talking. Soon, there is only the sound of the fallen cultivators' robes flipping in the wind...
10304044.ch: 二人说话间已去得远了，旷野之中，唯有虎虎长风，吹得倒伏地上的修仙者衣服猎猎作响……

10304045.en: You see {name|B} standing before you and pondering something with his head lowered. His face is surprisingly solemn.
10304045.ch: 只见{name|B}立于前方，正低头思索什么东西，其神色颇为凝重，迥异寻常

10304046.en: Oh, my saver, what are you talking about? I don't know what you mean.
10304046.ch: 哈？恩人，您说什么？我不太明白。

10304047.en: Ha! If someone said I was the best in the world, I'd just let them. Accusing me of releasing a monster is ridiculous! There must be some kind of misunderstanding.
10304047.ch: 嘿嘿，嘴是别人的，他们要说什么，我也无可奈何呀。释放妖兽？那个人也太高看我了。中间大概是有什么误会吧？

10304048.en: My saver, these are my research notes. I need a lot of preparation before an exploration, including researching these mystic realms.
10304048.ch: 恩人，这是我的研究笔记，我每次在外探索，都要耗费很多功夫做准备，其中就包括调查这些秘境。

10304049.en: Well. This notebook was used as a diary before, and as you know, I can't afford a second notebook. Therefore, I took this one to write down my findings from the research on mystic realms.
10304049.ch: 嘿嘿，这东西从前用来记录一些往事。你知道我一向贫寒，可买不起别的本子，可是查探秘境，又要做许多调查，便只好将就在这本子上写写画画了。

10304050.en: My saver, I need some more time. I'll tell you all you want to know after that.
10304050.ch: 恩人，请给我一点时间，之后我定会将一切来龙去脉告诉你的。

10304053.en: Good friend, do not trust him! He is trying to break the seals of a monster for some clues.
10304053.ch: 道友，千万不可听信此人言语。他为了获得线索，正逐步解开妖兽的封印。

10304054.en: Seals? Do you know that your seals brought ill fortune to a village and its people? They are innocent, and I just want to help them.
10304054.ch: 封印？你可知道你们的封印害惨了一个村子的凡人，他们有什么错？我解开封印是为了帮助他们。

10304055.en: Helping those mortals? They're just a means to an end for you! You're obsessed with obtaining a rare treasure known as the Illusion Spiritual Root.
10304055.ch: 你真的是为了凡人吗？你为的是自己！为的是你心心念念的宝物，那件宝物叫“九幻灵根”！

10304056.en: I don't know why you would say that. You said there is a sealed monster in Hua Feng, but if so, you should deal with it with your sect members. Why would you chase me all the way?
10304056.ch: 我不知道你在说什么。你说华封州有被封印的妖兽，既是如此，你们这些宗门高弟不是应该去对付妖兽吗？却来和我瞎纠缠什么？

10304057.en: My saver, please trust me. There is one final step in finishing my plan, but now I have no time to explain. I'll tell all things to you when the time comes.
10304057.ch: 恩人，请相信我，如今万事俱备，只差最后一步。但眼下已没时间解释明白了，请你相信我，后面我一定会给你一个说法。

10304058.en: Peer cultivator, he is lying! He dares to risk the whole Hua Feng for his own interest, and you should never trust him!
10304058.ch: 道友，此人说话不尽不实，只为一己之私，贻害华封州安危，万万不可轻信！

10304059.en: I don't want to fight you, but it seems that I have no choice...
10304059.ch: 我不想跟你动手，但看来此战无可避免……

10304060.en: Good... You defeated me. What will you do?
10304060.ch: 厉害……是我败了，你要怎地？

10304062.en: Okay. You saved my life, and I won't mind you to take it from me...
10304062.ch: 好，好，好！这条命是你救的，如今你要收回便拿去吧……

10304063.en: {name|B} gives up resistance. The cultivator at his side notices this chance and takes a decisive move to restrict him.
10304063.ch: {name|B}罢手就范，在旁的修仙者目光一闪，当机立断，出手将其制住他。

10304065.en: I won't let you free for Hua Feng's sake. Go back with me!
10304065.ch: 为了华封州的安宁，我不能放你，这便与我回去吧！

10304066.en: He has destroyed many suppressing seals against monsters, and I'll enhance the seals with members from other sects. After that, breaking them again should be more difficult.
10304066.ch: 此人已毁坏几处封印妖兽的镇煞封印，我已联合附近宗门一并将之重新加固，使旁人无法轻易破解。

10304067.en: But before we finish, he will be confined in our sect.
10304067.ch: 在那之前，只能将他禁锢于在下宗门之中了。

10304068.en: You should deal with him, but the method you see now is the least ideal one after taking Hua Feng and this world into consideration. I'll bring him back.
10304068.ch: 此人原本应由阁下处置，但为华封州计，为八荒计，不得不尔，在下先将人带走了。

10304069.en: And you contributed a lot in arresting him. Please take them as my gratitude.
10304069.ch: 阁下制住此人，功劳不小，这是在下小小心意，请收下。

10304070.en: The cultivator nods to you and draws {name|B} onto a flying sword. Then, they leave the spot...
10304070.ch: 修仙者说着对你略一点头，然后召出飞剑，抓着{name|B}离开了……

10304073.en: Ridiculous! We should never spare him, and now that my words failed, I'll resort to my force!
10304073.ch: 不明事理，此人断不能就此放过！说不得，在下只好用强了！

10304075.en: As {name|B} prepares to break the seal, a horrifying shriek echoes from afar. The two cultivators beside him turn towards the source of the sound, their faces etched with fear.
10304075.ch: {name|B}出手化解当前封印，但听远处传来一声可怖的枭叫。身旁二人转头看去，眼神中都透出一丝惧色。

10304076.en: The monster has been released. I won't let you escape now; you should be responsible for what you've done!
10304076.ch: 妖兽出世了，我不会放过你的，你应该为你做的事负责！

10304077.en: Let's go right now! We'll engage in another fight once his reinforcement arrives. Follow me!
10304077.ch: 咱们快走！不能留了，若此人召来援手，又得有一番纠缠。跟我来！

10304078.en: You and {name|B} walk along the way, and the village is not far from you. Suddenly, a shriek comes from behind, and {name|B} quivers slightly. He stands still and turns back to see the sound's source and looks hesitant.
10304078.ch: {name|B}与你一路前行，村子已在不远处外，但此时身后传来一声啸叫。{name|B}微微一震，突然站定回望啸声传出之处，脸上尽是犹豫之色。

10304079.en: My saver, the village head knows you are my friend, so please go there first for a visit. The village head will know my means once he sees you. I have urgent matters and must leave for a while.
10304079.ch: 恩人，村长知道你是我的朋友，请你前往村中，村长见你，便明白我的意思。我另有要事，不得不先离开一下。

10304080.en: {name|B}'s eyes light up with excitement as he rushes towards the source of the shriek.
10304080.ch: {name|B}朝你嘻嘻一笑，便快步朝啸声传出的地方去了。

10304081.en: You come to the village. Grateful tears stream down from the village head's face as he sees you. He kneels down and presses his forehead to the ground before you and asks others to present you with a plain, antique wooden carving.
10304081.ch: 而你来到村中，村长乍见你面，立即感激涕零，跪倒叩拜。他还命旁人取来一截古朴老旧的木雕呈到你手，并告诉你这是答应交给{name|B}的东西。

10304082.en: But the village head hopes you don't give it to {name|B}.
10304082.ch: 然而村长却希望你不要将此物交给{name|B}。

10304083.en: With many deep bows, the village head tells you the reason.
10304083.ch: 村长一边叩拜一边说出了原由。

10304084.en: The village's Feng Shui was affected by the seals suppressing the monster, and disasters fell here frequently. The village will even be wiped out soon.
10304084.ch: 原来村中因为压制妖兽的封印而影响了风水，致使这条小村落劫难四起，不久的将来还会迎来灭顶之灾。

10304085.en: However, things became better when {name|B} came here some days before and agreed to remove the seals to restore the Feng Shui of the village, in exchange for a stub he called the clue.
10304085.ch: 然而此事迎来了转机，{name|B}不久前来到此处，并答应为村落解除封印，恢复风水形势。但代价就是村长必须交出作为“线索”的幻根。

10304086.en: Since the village head hoped to solve the disaster for the village, he agreed with {name|B}'s condition. But to his surprise, {name|B} really managed to break the seals and did a huge favor for him and his people. Therefore, the village head was caught in a dilemma...
10304086.ch: 村长一心解除村中的厄难，当下便答应了{name|B}的请求。然而{name|B}却成功解除封印，对自己有恩，对村子有恩，因此这下又犯起难来了。

10304087.en: The clue he asked led to an ancient spiritual item, but getting such a treasure would result in a depleted lifespan. Out of an unwillingness to see {name|B} being harmed, the village head decided to hide the clue to prevent him from hurting himself.
10304087.ch: 因为“线索”直指一件远古灵物的所在位置。取得此物，必然招致折损自身寿元。村长思量，{name|B}取得秘宝，实是大害，因此希望还是不要将此物交给他，以免其为取宝物而受到伤害。

10304088.en: The village head presses his forehead to the ground again and blames himself for being so selfish. However, he insists you not to hand the stub to {name|B}.
10304088.ch: 村长一面叩拜，一面谴责自己自私，只盼望你不要将幻根交到{name|B}手中。

10304089.en: {name|B} seems to be heading there. Should I hand the clue to him?
10304089.ch: {name|B}似乎朝那边去了，要不要将“线索”交给他呢？

10304090.en: The village head presses his forehead to the ground again and expresses his gratitude to you. However, he insists you not to hand the clue to {name|B} for his sake.
10304090.ch: 村长一边叩拜，一边道谢，只说希望你不要将线索交到{name|B}手中。

10304092.en: You squeeze the stub into powders and see strands of bluish Qi. These ethereal strands float in the air and finally merge into an indication that leads to somewhere in the distance.
10304092.ch: 你掐碎幻根后，其迸出大量蔚蓝色的灵气，这些气息散而复聚，一缕一缕的犹如烟云指向远方某地。

10304093.en: There is a lush realm inside the vast wilderness. An open space reveals itself behind flowers and willows, and the bluish strands from the stub disappear into the place.
10304093.ch: 旷野之中，隐含一处草木茂盛的秘境，分花拂柳后，面前霍然开朗。而幻根灵烟传至此处亦缓缓消散。

10304094.en: You put your hands into where the smoke indicates and pull a wooden carving out from the earth. A strange attraction comes from it, and before you notice such an odd condition, the carving begins to draw essence from you...
10304094.ch: 你伸手探入灵根烟气所示之处，从地上抓出一条木雕。那根木雕在你手中立即生出一股吸力，你正觉不妙，他已不断吸取你的真元……

10304095.en: You feel your body limp, and the carving drops from your hands. But when you pick it up again, it has turned into a crystalline object resembling some gems.
10304095.ch: 你全身气力一弱，禁不住放脱此物，再次拾起时，那根木雕已经变得晶莹剔透，变得宝石也似。

10304096.en: The Illusion Root is drawing your essence and energy. You feel an emptiness inside you...
10304096.ch: 九幻灵根持续吸噬你体内真元以及灵力，让你感觉体内生出一阵空虚之感……

10304097.en: Several cultivators are fighting against a monster before you. {name|B} is kneeling on the ground; his face is pale as dead, and a stream of blood flows down from his mouth corner. He has been wounded badly, and the monster, after knocking down another cultivator, lets out a horrible shriek...
10304097.ch: 前方数名修仙者正与一只妖兽恶斗，{name|B}脸苍白如死，嘴角流血，跪倒地上，身受重伤。而那妖兽只眨眼间又击倒一名与之缠斗的修仙者，随后发出一声震啸……

10304098.en: The monster is engaging in a tough battle against cultivators. Sensing your presence, it breaks out from the surrounding cultivators and charges at you with a deafening shriek.
10304098.ch: 妖兽正与众修仙者缠斗，你才接近，忙摆脱纠缠的修仙者，猛发一声长啸朝你猛冲而至。

10304099.en: Oh, my saver! Now the monster is under the effect of the bane and has been greatly weakened. Time to kill it!
10304099.ch: 啊！是恩人！妖兽遭到克制之物牵制，如今实力大减，正是击杀的良机！

10304102.en: The cultivators all look relieved after killing the monster. {name|B} sits on the ground exhaustedly, and the lead cultivator glares at him with a fierce expression...
10304102.ch: 击杀妖兽后，众人总算吁了口气。为首的修仙者杀气腾腾的盯着坐倒地上的{name|B}……

10304103.en: You ignored the overall situation and released the monster secretly. Your action put Hua Feng in danger, and we also suffered losses and causalities to kill it. You must be held responsible for what you've done!
10304103.ch: 你不顾大局，私自放出妖兽，让华封州增加了无数危机，也让我等大费周章，出力围剿，实是罪不容诛！

10304104.en: Alright... Kill me if you like...

10304105.en: However, you assisted us in eliminating the monster and were wounded seriously, and Hua Feng finally got rid of a potential danger. Your merits and demerits offset each other.
10304105.ch: 但此后你协助我等击杀妖兽，身受重伤，华封州因此免去长久以来的隐患，总算功过相抵！

10304107.en: Well, eh... No need to worry me. Just some dizziness from exposure to the sun.
10304107.ch: 咦！嘿嘿……不碍事，日头太晒，有点头晕而已。

10304108.en: Thank you, peer cultivator... If there were not you to kill it, we would suffer heavy causalities.
10304108.ch: 道友，多谢你此番相助……若非有你击杀妖兽，只靠我等，恐怕得死伤枕席了。

10304109.en: You helped us a lot in this battle. Here, I prepared a gift on behalf of my sect, please accept it.
10304109.ch: 道友是诛杀妖兽的大功臣，这是在下替宗门送的一点薄礼，盼你不吝收下。

10304110.en: The cultivator nods to you and leads the sect member to leave. After seeing them away, {name|B} turns to you.
10304110.ch: 修仙者朝你微一点头后后，指挥门人离开了。{name|B}目送众人离开后，便立即转头看着你。

10304111.en: My saver! Has the village head handed the clue to you?
10304111.ch: 恩人！村长是否已经将“线索”交给你了？

10304112.en: Good, the village head kept his word! Then, could you come with me, my saver? I would like you to witness such a moment with me, hehe!
10304112.ch: 很好，村长果然信守承诺！恩人，你可以陪我来一下吗？我还是想请你见证一下这个重要的时刻呢！嘿嘿！

10304114.en: Alright, I see. My saver, did you know it from the village head? I have spent too much time and effort on finding it, and now I can't give up since the final aim is just before me.
10304114.ch: 哈哈，我知道了！恩人，是村长告诉你的吧？我在这件事上已经耗费太多的时间、精力了，当下终点就在眼前，我是不可能停下来的。

10304115.en: But my saver, thank you very much.

10304116.en: {name|B}'s eyes shine with utter determination. He leads the way and strides to the destination.
10304116.ch: {name|B}眼神之中充满了坚毅，他走在前头，大踏步往他的目的地行进。

10304118.en: Here is the place indicated by the stub. My saver, thank you for your help all the way. You saved me from an imminent death, and though I felt beholden to you, I also wanted to find the Illusion Root with your help.
10304118.ch: 幻根所示，便是此处。恩人，多谢你一直以来的帮助。你一开始救我水火之中，虽然我心存感激，却盼着借你之手协助我找到九幻灵根。

10304119.en: I feel both grateful and guilty to you. Please forgive what I have done to you.
10304119.ch: 我对你既怀感激，亦抱愧疚。这一切一切真是对不起之至。

10304120.en: No. I must keep my promise. I made it for you, as well as for the deceased brother.
10304120.ch: 不，无论是对你，还是昔日故人，我都有过承诺，不能不遵守的。

10304121.en: {name|B} shakes his head with a smile. Suddenly, he grits his teeth and stretches out his hands into the soil. He pulls something out after piercing the ground into its deep with ease, and the object he is holding looks like a wooden carving.
10304121.ch: {name|B}微笑着摇了摇头，突然咬牙伸手探入地下，他双手如无隔碍般穿过地表，然后哗啦一下抽出，手中已拿着一截木雕也似的物品。

10304122.en: The carving was shabby and worn out at the moment he excavated it, but just as {name|B} grasped it, the object emitted a bright beam. It turns into a crystalline, gem-like sculpture in an instant, while {name|B}'s face is pale as dead as if he is in his last breath.
10304122.ch: 那木雕起出之时老旧残破，但一到{name|B}手中，立即发出光华，只片刻间已变成一截晶莹剔透的宝石般的晶雕。而握持晶雕的{name|B}脸色苍白如死，已然奄奄一息。

10304123.en: {name|B} grits his teeth and stretches out his hands into the soil. He pulls something out after piercing the ground into its deep with ease, and the object he is holding looks like a wooden carving.
10304123.ch: {name|B}咬了咬牙伸手探入地下，他双手如无隔碍般穿过地表，然后哗啦一下抽出，手中已拿着一截木雕也似的物品。

10304125.en: With fierce coughs, {name|B} presents you with the crystalline sculpture with trembling hands...
10304125.ch: {name|B}咳嗽着用颤颤巍巍的手将那件宝石般的根雕递到你面前来……

10304126.en: This is the Illusion Root. Remember? I promised you a treasure when we met the first time.
10304126.ch: 这，便是九幻灵根。恩人，还记得你我初见之际，我曾许以承诺，要送你一件宝物吗？

10304127.en: And here it is. My saver, please take my gift.
10304127.ch: 恩人，九幻灵根便是我要送你的宝物。请收下吧？

10304128.en: Yes. I did many things without telling them to you, and I know you would feel annoyed by that. What do you want to know?
10304128.ch: 是，我瞒着恩人做了不少事情呢，也难怪您心里不舒服。你有什么想知道的呢？

10304129.en: I traveled far and wide to find the Illusion Root, and finally, I got a clue. It said that the Illusion Root had an imaged self, a stub, in Hua Feng, and once I found the stub, I could position the Root with it. However, the stub was kept in a secluded tiny village. I tried several times to steal it, but I failed.
10304129.ch: 恩人，我为寻找秘宝九幻灵根，踏遍千山万水，终于得到了一条线索。九幻灵根曾生成幻根留存于华封州中。只要寻得幻根就能推断九幻灵根的确切位置，然而幻根却为一个清幽的小村落所有。我几次意欲窃取都告失败。

10304130.en: I had no choice but to ask the village head for help. The head requested me to investigate the hidden danger in their village, but in the end, I found that the village's Feng Shui was affected by a suppression seal against monsters in Hua Feng.
10304130.ch: 无奈下只得请求村长帮忙，村长便拜托我为他们查明村中隐患。然而彻查后方知，一处镇压华封州妖兽的封印辗转影响到此处村落的风水形势。

10304131.en: The village and its people thus got involved. But mortal villagers were innocent and could never resist such a disaster, so I must solve such a seal for them, as well as for myself.
10304131.ch: 镇压妖兽的封印影响了那个小村子，村民是无辜的，他们身无修为，根本没有办法对抗灾劫。为人为己，我都势需解除那个封印。

10304132.en: You get the point. Because of that, I immediately set out for a method to counter the monster after I broke the seal. However, the cultivators in Hua Feng soon noticed my action.
10304132.ch: 恩人说得是。因此我决定捣毁封印后，便开始着手另寻克制妖兽的法子。可惜，我没过多久便被华封州的修仙者察觉我在破坏封印。

10304133.en: Therefore, I must continue my work while escaping their chase. I was caught in danger many times and had several narrow escapes, and I survived thanks to your help.
10304133.ch: 我一边躲避来人的纠缠，一边破除封印，中间经历危机，几乎丧命，最后还是得恩人搭救帮忙，这才渡过难关。

10304134.en: My apologies, I should never take advantage of someone who saved my life! Our fight against the blood puppet helped me to get the monster's bane that will counter it in Hua Feng, and all other fights aimed at the clues for breaking the monster's seal.
10304134.ch: 恩人于我有救命之恩，在下实在万万不该这样做的！那次击杀血傀是为了取得克制华封州妖兽克制之物，其余都是为了获得破除妖兽封印的线索。

10304135.en: The explorations and treasure hunts were all pretexts... I thought it would be too difficult for me if I did them alone, so I invited you to follow and assist me.
10304135.ch: 所谓给恩人探秘挖宝都是、都是借口……只是我一个人要完成这些事过于勉为其难，因此希望恩人陪伴在侧，予以协助。

10304136.en: It has been used up. We headed to different destinations after we got rid of the cultivators in Hua Feng. You went to the village for the stub, and I turned back to join their fight against the monster. Then, I felt my enemy was formidable and could only take out its bane.
10304136.ch: 妖兽克制之物已经使用了。当时摆脱华封州修仙者后，你我分头行事，你到村子取得幻根，而我则回头协助他们围剿妖兽。妖兽果然颇为强大，我立即祭出克制物对付妖兽。

10304137.en: Luckily, my tactics were effective and won us some time. However, the fight was still very tough, and if you didn't come there and eliminate the monster, our fight would eventually lose. The disturbance was due to my search for the Root and the destruction of the seals, and I also feel guilty...
10304137.ch: 妖兽遭到克制，实力减弱，不过大家仍是抵敌不过，若非你后来赶到击杀妖兽，可能我们还是免不了大败亏输。这一切都是因为我为取九幻灵根，破坏封印掀起的风波，我心中也是十分愧疚……

10304138.en: It's a long story. I had a sworn older brother in the past, and he did me a favor. His wish throughout life was to get the Illusion Root. However, my brother was too obsessed with his pursuit and passed away due to exhaustion. I thought I should dissuade him from such an aim and often blamed myself for failing to do so.
10304138.ch: 这却是一段往事了。昔年在下有一义兄，曾于我有恩。他生平愿望，便是取得九幻灵根。可惜，义兄为了九幻灵根，沉溺太过，最后耗尽心力而亡。我没有规劝他及早罢手，心中十分自责。

10304139.en: I suffered a lot from the thought. My mind would be irritated whenever I meditated, and I couldn't even enjoy a peaceful daily life, let alone break through realms.
10304139.ch: 为此，我时常无法静下心来，一旦打坐便即心潮起伏，不说无法突破境界了，就是平日亦是寝食难安。

10304140.en: Finding the Illusion Root was my brother's last will, and it also became my preoccupation. So I must continue the search and make our wish come true.
10304140.ch: 寻得九幻灵根是义兄的遗愿，而我也为此时种下心病，故而我无论如何，也得完成此事，找到九幻灵根。

10304141.en: Of course, I'll die if my life runs out. But I have finally got the Illusion Root and present it to you, that is to say, I've made good on the promises to you and to my brother. My wishes are fulfilled.
10304141.ch: 寿尽即亡，天之常理。答应恩人的要做到，答应义兄的事情也必须做到。如今取得九幻灵根，并赠予恩人之手，一下完成了两件大事，在下于愿已足。

10304142.en: Besides, I couldn't make any breakthrough due to my feelings of guilt in the past. Now that the burden in my mind has been lifted, I should be able to break through to the next realm. Once I make it, I'll get my lifespan extended and could offset the depleted life.
10304142.ch: 从前我因为愧疚自责，总是无法突破境界。如今心结一朝解开，此后应能顺利突破了。只要境界修为上去了，寿命自然也再度延长了。小小折寿，于我性命，并无太大影响。

10304143.en: Years of effort have finally paid off...
10304143.ch: 多年夙愿，总算有了个了结……

10304144.en: But my saver, I have another request. The Illusion Root has been shaped, but it should be planted somewhere again to take effect.
10304144.ch: 恩人，请恕在下还有一个请求。九幻灵根眼下虽已成型，但仍需重新种下才能发挥妙用。

10304145.en: My sworn brother's wish was to get it, but as you know, he passed away. I buried him in a secluded place.
10304145.ch: 在下义兄昔日心心念念盼望着能够取得九幻灵根，后来因故去世，为我安葬在一处隐秘的清幽之处。

10304146.en: So, would you please plant the Illusion Root beside his tomb? I guess he would be glad to look at the treasure all day.
10304146.ch: 可否请你将九幻灵根种在他的安葬之处，让他得以日夜看见这件秘宝。
